## Goal

把"每个单元 1 个 cell 的 n=384 formal"推进为设计文档要求的**有意义网格 + protection-aware 对照 + F5/F6 机理模式 + FS 管线**，期间修复已发现的工具正确性 bug（本分支主题），最终产出可信的 §4.1 逃逸分解与 §4.2 保护投资排序。

## 现状一句话总结（详见 findings.md）

S1 四个 P0 单元 + S2/S3 六个 SE 单元 formal 已完成（单 cell × n=384）；核心格局：**乱序后端（PRF/RAT/LSQFwd）DUE 主导 92–100%，存储（L1D）SDC 主导 97.7%，执行/IQ/译码/BPU/RAS 全 Masked**。但存在：① mem_formal 全 Inactive（CHAOSMem 频率 bug，同 8bff9d1 修过的那类）；② 6 个 formal 结果未提交；③ 几乎所有 formal 只跑了 `protection_model=none` 单组、单 fault_model、target_index=0 单 cell —— 与设计文档 §1.2/§2.x C 的网格规格相差甚远；④ F5/F6 子模式（ROB spec_leak、IQ src_ready/tag_sub、LSQFwd fwd_source_sub/phaseOffset、TLB pfn→活页）全部 deferred；⑤ FS 管线（kp920_proxy_fs V110 参数、checkpoint 流水线、PTW H7 formal）未落地。

---

## Phase 1 — 工具正确性 + 在手结果落盘（本分支主题，最高优先）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

1. ✅ 6 个 formal 提交（d4c9e8b）：bpu/decode/ras/iq 全 Masked 384/384；mem 标注无效。
2. ✅ CHAOSMem 频率 bug 修复（b7433dd）：ratio 由时钟频率按 gem5 舍入规则计算（C2→385，C0→500）。真机验证 Tick 精确等于 first_clock×ratio。
3. ✅ mem_formal 重跑（d88dcc7）：**VALID，384/384 Masked，P_SDC=0% [0,1.0]**——DRAM 后备字节被 L1/L2 缓存掩盖（与 L1D 97.7% SDC 对照鲜明）。附带修复 campaign.py --jobs>1 pickle bug（_PoolRep 模块级类；此前所有 formal 都是串行跑的，掩盖了此 bug）。

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

## Phase 2 — protection-aware 第二组（§1.2 核心缺口，改结论级别的补强）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

/*
 * chaos_event_sample.hh — v1.1 Phase 8.2 uniform event-sampling helper
 * (design doc §1.7 rule 4; task_plan Phase 8.2).
 *
 * PROBLEM (the geometric-skip bias): every CHAOS hook-on-event injector
 * (FPU/Exec/L1DForward/LSQFwd/IQ/...) draws
 *     events_to_skip ~ geometric(p=0.1)
 * from its RNG to land maxFaults=1 on a "seed-dependent" eligible event.
 * geometric(0.1) has MEAN 10 and a heavy forward skew: P(skip <= 30) ≈ 96%.
 * Under a long ROI with thousands of eligible events, the single fault
 * therefore lands in the FIRST ~30 events for almost every rep — the
 * sampled "distribution" is not the eligible-event distribution at all,
 * it is the head of it (findings.md Phase 3.0 family; the l1dfwd formal
 * measured one squashed wrong-path load until this was patched, and even
 * the patched version only spreads over the head).
 *
 * FIX (two-piece, per the design doc):
 *  1. countOnlyMode: the injector CONSUMES eligible events without
 *     corrupting and prints
 *         CHAOS_ELIGIBLE_COUNT=<n>
 *     to its log at end-of-sim (or when counting is stopped). A driver
 *     (campaign.py) dry-runs the cell once in count mode to learn
 *     N_eligible — the number of eligible events inside the ROI window.
 *  2. pickSkip(seed, nEligible): a seed-derived UNIFORM draw
 *         skip = lcg(seed) % nEligible
 *     so the single fault lands uniformly over [0, N_eligible). The
 *     driver passes the fixed skip back via the injector's
 *     eventsToSkip param (no per-injector RNG dependence for placement).
 *
 * The LCG is the same one the smoke kernels use (Knuth MMIX-ish
 * 6364136223846793005 / 1442695040888963407) — cheap, deterministic,
 * dependency-free, and identical across hosts (std::mt19937 is also
 * portable, but an explicit LCG keeps this header SimObject-free and
 * trivially auditable).
 *
 * Header-only: no SConscript entry needed (include path cpu/o3 is on
 * CPPPATH for all o3 sources and the CHAOS injector subdirs).
 */
#ifndef __CPU_O3_CHAOS_EVENT_SAMPLE_HH__
#define __CPU_O3_CHAOS_EVENT_SAMPLE_HH__

#include <cstdint>

namespace gem5
{

/** Seed-mixed LCG step — one round so the low bits are not the raw seed. */
inline uint64_t
chaosSampleLCG(uint64_t x)
{
    return x * 6364136223846793005ULL + 1442695040888963407ULL;
}

/**
 * Uniform skip over [0, nEligible). Returns 0 when nEligible == 0 (no
 * eligible events — inject on the first one, which will not exist
 * anyway). nEligible == 1 -> 0 (the only eligible event).
 */
inline uint64_t
chaosPickSkip(uint64_t seed, uint64_t n_eligible)
{
    if (n_eligible == 0) return 0;
    return chaosSampleLCG(seed ^ 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15ULL) % n_eligible;
}

} // namespace gem5

#endif // __CPU_O3_CHAOS_EVENT_SAMPLE_HH__

from m5.params import *
from m5.SimObject import SimObject

class CHAOSFPU(SimObject):
    type = 'CHAOSFPU'
    cxx_class = 'gem5::CHAOSFPU'
    cxx_header = "cpu/o3/CHAOSFPU/CHAOSFPU.hh"

    cpu = Param.BaseCPU(NULL, "Target CPU (must be an O3CPU)")

    # §2.6 floating-point / vector execution-unit fault injector. Hooks
    # DynInst::execute() AFTER staticInst->execute(); filters by opClass
    # (FloatAdd/FloatMult/FloatMultAcc + SimdFloat*); corrupts the FP result
    # blob by a single-bit XOR (IEEE754 sign/exp/mantissa bit).
    probability = Param.Float(1.0, "per-execute injection probability")
    firstClock = Param.UInt64(0, "first clock cycle eligible for injection")
    lastClock = Param.UInt64(0, "last cycle (0 = unrestricted)")
    faultMask = Param.UInt64(0, "bitmask for the FP result XOR (0 = random single bit)")
    maxFaults = Param.UInt64(0, "max faults; 0 = unlimited. Use 1.")
    rngSeed = Param.UInt64(0, "RNG seed (0 = random_device)")
    writeLog = Param.Bool(True, "Write a fault_injections.log file")

input.old_string:
maxFaults = Param.UInt64(0, "max faults; 0 = unlimited. Use 1.")
    rngSeed = Param.UInt64(0, "RNG seed (0 = random_device)")
    writeLog = Param.Bool(True, "Write a fault_injections.log file")
input.new_string:
maxFaults = Param.UInt64(0, "max faults; 0 = unlimited. Use 1.")
    rngSeed = Param.UInt64(0, "RNG seed (0 = random_device)")
    # v1.1 Phase 8.2 uniform sampling (design doc §1.7 rule 4): the driver
    # dry-runs countOnly to learn N_eligible, then passes a FIXED uniform
    # skip here (chaosPickSkip(seed, N) from cpu/o3/chaos_event_sample.hh).
    # Default UINT64_MAX sentinel = legacy geometric(p=0.1) draw, so every
    # existing campaign replays byte-identically.
    eventsToSkip = Param.UInt64(0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF,
        "FIXED number of eligible events to skip before the first "
        "injection (uniform-sampling mode). Default UINT64_MAX = legacy "
        "geometric(0.1) draw from rngSeed.")
    countOnly = Param.Bool(False,
        "v1.1 Phase 8.2 countOnlyMode: consume eligible events and print "
        "CHAOS_ELIGIBLE_COUNT=<n> at teardown, never corrupt.")
    writeLog = Param.Bool(True, "Write a fault_injections.log file")

## Goal

把"每个单元 1 个 cell 的 n=384 formal"推进为设计文档要求的**有意义网格 + protection-aware 对照 + F5/F6 机理模式 + FS 管线**，期间修复已发现的工具正确性 bug（本分支主题），最终产出可信的 §4.1 逃逸分解与 §4.2 保护投资排序。

## 现状一句话总结（详见 findings.md）

S1 四个 P0 单元 + S2/S3 六个 SE 单元 formal 已完成（单 cell × n=384）；核心格局：**乱序后端（PRF/RAT/LSQFwd）DUE 主导 92–100%，存储（L1D）SDC 主导 97.7%，执行/IQ/译码/BPU/RAS 全 Masked**。但存在：① mem_formal 全 Inactive（CHAOSMem 频率 bug，同 8bff9d1 修过的那类）；② 6 个 formal 结果未提交；③ 几乎所有 formal 只跑了 `protection_model=none` 单组、单 fault_model、target_index=0 单 cell —— 与设计文档 §1.2/§2.x C 的网格规格相差甚远；④ F5/F6 子模式（ROB spec_leak、IQ src_ready/tag_sub、LSQFwd fwd_source_sub/phaseOffset、TLB pfn→活页）全部 deferred；⑤ FS 管线（kp920_proxy_fs V110 参数、checkpoint 流水线、PTW H7 formal）未落地。

---

## Phase 1 — 工具正确性 + 在手结果落盘（本分支主题，最高优先）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

1. ✅ 6 个 formal 提交（d4c9e8b）：bpu/decode/ras/iq 全 Masked 384/384；mem 标注无效。
2. ✅ CHAOSMem 频率 bug 修复（b7433dd）：ratio 由时钟频率按 gem5 舍入规则计算（C2→385，C0→500）。真机验证 Tick 精确等于 first_clock×ratio。
3. ✅ mem_formal 重跑（d88dcc7）：**VALID，384/384 Masked，P_SDC=0% [0,1.0]**——DRAM 后备字节被 L1/L2 缓存掩盖（与 L1D 97.7% SDC 对照鲜明）。附带修复 campaign.py --jobs>1 pickle bug（_PoolRep 模块级类；此前所有 formal 都是串行跑的，掩盖了此 bug）。

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

## Phase 2 — protection-aware 第二组（§1.2 核心缺口，改结论级别的补强）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

for D in CHAOSExec CHAOSL1DForward CHAOSIQ CHAOSLSQFwd; do
python3 - <<EOF
import re
p = "CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/$D/$D.py"
s = open(p).read()
old = '''    rngSeed = Param.UInt64(0, "RNG seed (0 = random_device)")'''
new = '''    rngSeed = Param.UInt64(0, "RNG seed (0 = random_device)")
    # v1.1 Phase 8.2 uniform sampling (design doc §1.7 rule 4): FIXED skip
    # from the driver's chaosPickSkip(seed, N_eligible) overrides the
    # legacy geometric(p=0.1) draw. UINT64_MAX sentinel = legacy behavior.
    eventsToSkip = Param.UInt64(0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF,
        "FIXED number of eligible events to skip before the first "
        "injection (uniform-sampling mode). Default UINT64_MAX = legacy "
        "geometric(0.1) draw from rngSeed.")
    countOnly = Param.Bool(False,
        "v1.1 Phase 8.2 countOnlyMode: consume eligible events and print "
        "CHAOS_ELIGIBLE_COUNT=<n> at teardown, never corrupt.")'''
assert s.count(old) == 1, p
open(p, "w").write(s.replace(old, new))
print("patched", p)
EOF
done

# 下一步计划：鲲鹏920 SDC 故障注入 — S2/S3 收尾 → 网格深化 → F5/F6 → FS → v1.1 补救轮

> 依据 `docs/KUNPENG920-故障注入方案详细工程设计.md`（§3.1 阶段表）× 仓库实际进展（HEAD af64ef7 + 未提交 formal 结果）编写。
> **v1.1 补救轮（Phase 8–12）** 依据工程设计文档 v1.1（§1.3 故障模型必跑矩阵 + §1.7 负载/oracle 纪律 + §2.3/2.6/2.8/2.17）× `KUNPENG920-v1.1补救轮执行计划.md`；落地仓库 `gem5-fi/`（分支 `fix/fi-tool-correctness`，真 HEAD `4bf8d0d` = 238 commits）。
> 本计划是**工作计划**；证据审计结论见 `findings.md`。

## Goal

把"每个单元 1 个 cell 的 n=384 formal"推进为设计文档要求的**有意义网格 + protection-aware 对照 + F5/F6 机理模式 + FS 管线**，期间修复已发现的工具正确性 bug（本分支主题），最终产出可信的 §4.1 逃逸分解与 §4.2 保护投资排序。

## 现状一句话总结（详见 findings.md）

S1 四个 P0 单元 + S2/S3 六个 SE 单元 formal 已完成（单 cell × n=384）；核心格局：**乱序后端（PRF/RAT/LSQFwd）DUE 主导 92–100%，存储（L1D）SDC 主导 97.7%，执行/IQ/译码/BPU/RAS 全 Masked**。但存在：① mem_formal 全 Inactive（CHAOSMem 频率 bug，同 8bff9d1 修过的那类）；② 6 个 formal 结果未提交；③ 几乎所有 formal 只跑了 `protection_model=none` 单组、单 fault_model、target_index=0 单 cell —— 与设计文档 §1.2/§2.x C 的网格规格相差甚远；④ F5/F6 子模式（ROB spec_leak、IQ src_ready/tag_sub、LSQFwd fwd_source_sub/phaseOffset、TLB pfn→活页）全部 deferred；⑤ FS 管线（kp920_proxy_fs V110 参数、checkpoint 流水线、PTW H7 formal）未落地。

---

## Phase 1 — 工具正确性 + 在手结果落盘（本分支主题，最高优先）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

1. ✅ 6 个 formal 提交（d4c9e8b）：bpu/decode/ras/iq 全 Masked 384/384；mem 标注无效。
2. ✅ CHAOSMem 频率 bug 修复（b7433dd）：ratio 由时钟频率按 gem5 舍入规则计算（C2→385，C0→500）。真机验证 Tick 精确等于 first_clock×ratio。
3. ✅ mem_formal 重跑（d88dcc7）：**VALID，384/384 Masked，P_SDC=0% [0,1.0]**——DRAM 后备字节被 L1/L2 缓存掩盖（与 L1D 97.7% SDC 对照鲜明）。附带修复 campaign.py --jobs>1 pickle bug（_PoolRep 模块级类；此前所有 formal 都是串行跑的，掩盖了此 bug）。

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

## Phase 2 — protection-aware 第二组（§1.2 核心缺口，改结论级别的补强）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**


===END-PWF-DATA kind=plan nonce=f45079ceaf3f7e79b49975f3==="}}

content.subject: Phase 8.1 — 非 hash oracle(classify/runner/campaign/schema)
content.description: classify_run() 加 oracle_kind 参数(array_hash/per_element_diff/fp_ulp);runner.py GOLDEN_ARRAYS 注册表 + oracle.kind/tol 透传;campaign.py manifest_for_cell() 写 workload.oracle_kind/oracle_tol;manifest.schema.json v2 enum 增补。验收:烟雾 kernel 手工注入验证三种 oracle + reg_chain exact_hash 不变。

content.subject: Phase 8.2 — events_to_skip 均匀采样
content.description: 新 src/cpu/o3/chaos_event_sample.hh:pickSkip(seed,nEligible)=rng%nEligible + countOnlyMode 打印 CHAOS_ELIGIBLE_COUNT。campaign.py dry-run 计数 N_eligible → skip=uniform。六注入器(FPU/Exec/L1DForward/LSQFwd/IQ/ROB)采样切 helper。验收:同 cell 5 seed 注入事件分散 + reg_chain golden 回归。

content.subject: Phase 8.3 — CHAOSCache/CHAOSMem local_mbu 多位档
content.description: faultMask=0 时按 bitsToChange 生成相邻多位掩码;applyProtection() 2-bit(poison/Latent)与 ≥3-bit(SilentEscape)分支走通。验收:secded_poison+bits=2→log Latent;bits=3→SilentEscape。

content.subject: Phase 8.4 — recurring_result_stuck 单故障契约松绑
content.description: runner.py 仅 fault.model==recurring_result_stuck 时允许 max_faults==0;campaign.py 对该模型 cell 发 limits.max_faults=0;schemas 放开。验收:recurring cell 跑通 N>1 损坏+九类结局+Wilson CI;transient cell 仍断言 ∈{0,1}。

content.subject: Phase 8 总验收
content.description: 0a–0d 四项验收 + reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归(exit 0,零 SIGSEGV)。更新 progress.md/task_plan.md。

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- manifest write

def manifest_for_cell(campaign, cell, cell_ordinal, rep, outdir):
    """Build an arm-chaos-fi/v1 manifest (reuses the EXISTING v1 schema that
    runner.py validates) for one (cell, rep), write it to outdir, return path.

    Seed rule (§1.5): base_seed + cell_ordinal*1000 + rep -> deterministic,
    reproducible across machines.
    """
    wl = campaign["workload"]
    inj = campaign["injector"]
    limits = campaign.get("limits", {})
    base = campaign["base_seed"]
    seed = base + cell_ordinal * 1000 + rep
    run_id = f"{campaign['campaign_id']}-c{cell_ordinal:04d}-r{rep:04d}"

    # H2 microarch axes (rob/phys_int/phys_float/lq/sq) live in the grid
    # alongside fault axes but are config knobs, not fault fields. Pull them
    # out of the cell so they flow to platform.config_params only.
    MICROARCH_AXES = ("rob", "phys_int", "phys_float", "lq", "sq")
    config_params = {k: cell[k] for k in MICROARCH_AXES if k in cell}
    cell = {k: v for k, v in cell.items() if k not in MICROARCH_AXES}

    # forward-declaration placeholder from when runner.py only knew rat —
    # that silently re-routed those campaigns' manifests to the RAT
    # injector (rob/iq formals were invalid; found 2026-09-04, fixed here).

lines: ## Phase 8 — v1.1/P0：基础设施（解锁 Phase 9–11，先做）

1. **非 hash oracle**（0a + 载体 0f）：`tools/classify.py` `classify_run()` 加 `oracle_kind` 参数——`array_hash`（kernel 打印 `ARRAYHASH=<64hex>`，比对该行）/ `per_element_diff`（打印 `ELEMDIFF n=<count> first=<idx> maxulp=<n>`，`count>0`→SDC，first/maxulp 带进 reason）/ `fp_ulp`（打印 `ULP=<max_ulp_error>`，`>tol`→SDC，`<=tol`→Masked 即使 bit 不精确一致）。`tools/runner.py` manifest `oracle.kind`/`oracle.tol` → `classify_run`；加 `GOLDEN_ARRAYS` 注册表（`golden_id → artifacts/golden/<id>.bin`，与 `GOLDEN_IDS` 并列，`--golden-array` CLI 覆盖）。`tools/campaign.py` `manifest_for_cell()` 写 `workload.oracle_kind`/`oracle_tol`；`schemas/manifest.schema.json` v2 `oracle.kind` enum 增补。**验收**：临时 elemwise 风格烟雾 kernel + 手工注入，`per_element_diff` 报出 first/maxulp，`fp_ulp` 在 tol 两侧分别判 Masked/SDC，`array_hash` 无注入回归 == golden；`reg_chain` exact_hash 路径不变。**补丁 1–2**。

2. **`events_to_skip` 均匀采样**（0b + 载体 0e，§1.7 rule 4）：现状几何分布 p=0.1（均值 10，前置偏斜——长 ROI 下注入点集中在前 ~30 个 eligible 事件）。新写 `CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/chaos_event_sample.hh`：`pickSkip(seed, nEligible) = rng(seed) % nEligible` + `countOnlyMode`（消费 eligible 事件、打印 `CHAOS_ELIGIBLE_COUNT=<n>`、不损坏）。注入器加 `--count_only` 模式；`campaign.py` 先对每个 (kernel, trigger) dry-run 计数 ROI 内 eligible 数 `N_eligible` → `skip = uniform(0, N_eligible-1)`（seed 派生，可重放）。`CHAOSFPU / CHAOSExec / CHAOSL1DForward / CHAOSLSQFwd / CHAOSIQ / CHAOSROB` 六注入器采样切到 helper（config 传入固定 `events_to_skip`，不再各自几何分布）。**验收**：同一 cell 换 5 seed，注入的动态事件（tick / seqNum）分散（不再恒为同一条）；`reg_chain` golden 回归。**补丁 2–3**。

# 下一步计划：鲲鹏920 SDC 故障注入 — S2/S3 收尾 → 网格深化 → F5/F6 → FS → v1.1 补救轮

> **v1.1 补救轮（Phase 8–12）** 依据工程设计文档 v1.1（§1.3 故障模型必跑矩阵 + §1.7 负载/oracle 纪律 + §2.3/2.6/2.8/2.17）× `KUNPENG920-v1.1补救轮执行计划.md`；落地仓库 `gem5-fi/`（分支 `fix/fi-tool-correctness`，真 HEAD `4bf8d0d` = 238 commits）。
> 本计划是**工作计划**；证据审计结论见 `findings.md`。

## Goal

把"每个单元 1 个 cell 的 n=384 formal"推进为设计文档要求的**有意义网格 + protection-aware 对照 + F5/F6 机理模式 + FS 管线**，期间修复已发现的工具正确性 bug（本分支主题），最终产出可信的 §4.1 逃逸分解与 §4.2 保护投资排序。

## 现状一句话总结（详见 findings.md）

S1 四个 P0 单元 + S2/S3 六个 SE 单元 formal 已完成（单 cell × n=384）；核心格局：**乱序后端（PRF/RAT/LSQFwd）DUE 主导 92–100%，存储（L1D）SDC 主导 97.7%，执行/IQ/译码/BPU/RAS 全 Masked**。但存在：① mem_formal 全 Inactive（CHAOSMem 频率 bug，同 8bff9d1 修过的那类）；② 6 个 formal 结果未提交；③ 几乎所有 formal 只跑了 `protection_model=none` 单组、单 fault_model、target_index=0 单 cell —— 与设计文档 §1.2/§2.x C 的网格规格相差甚远；④ F5/F6 子模式（ROB spec_leak、IQ src_ready/tag_sub、LSQFwd fwd_source_sub/phaseOffset、TLB pfn→活页）全部 deferred；⑤ FS 管线（kp920_proxy_fs V110 参数、checkpoint 流水线、PTW H7 formal）未落地。

---

## Phase 1 — 工具正确性 + 在手结果落盘（本分支主题，最高优先）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

1. ✅ 6 个 formal 提交（d4c9e8b）：bpu/decode/ras/iq 全 Masked 384/384；mem 标注无效。
2. ✅ CHAOSMem 频率 bug 修复（b7433dd）：ratio 由时钟频率按 gem5 舍入规则计算（C2→385，C0→500）。真机验证 Tick 精确等于 first_clock×ratio。
3. ✅ mem_formal 重跑（d88dcc7）：**VALID，384/384 Masked，P_SDC=0% [0,1.0]**——DRAM 后备字节被 L1/L2 缓存掩盖（与 L1D 97.7% SDC 对照鲜明）。附带修复 campaign.py --jobs>1 pickle bug（_PoolRep 模块级类；此前所有 formal 都是串行跑的，掩盖了此 bug）。

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

## Phase 2 — protection-aware 第二组（§1.2 核心缺口，改结论级别的补强）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

> **v1.1 补救轮（Phase 8–12）** 依据工程设计文档 v1.1（§1.3 故障模型必跑矩阵 + §1.7 负载/oracle 纪律 + §2.3/2.6/2.8/2.17）× `KUNPENG920-v1.1补救轮执行计划.md`；落地仓库 `gem5-fi/`（分支 `fix/fi-tool-correctness`，真 HEAD `4bf8d0d` = 238 commits）。
> 本计划是**工作计划**；证据审计结论见 `findings.md`。

## Goal

把"每个单元 1 个 cell 的 n=384 formal"推进为设计文档要求的**有意义网格 + protection-aware 对照 + F5/F6 机理模式 + FS 管线**，期间修复已发现的工具正确性 bug（本分支主题），最终产出可信的 §4.1 逃逸分解与 §4.2 保护投资排序。

## 现状一句话总结（详见 findings.md）

S1 四个 P0 单元 + S2/S3 六个 SE 单元 formal 已完成（单 cell × n=384）；核心格局：**乱序后端（PRF/RAT/LSQFwd）DUE 主导 92–100%，存储（L1D）SDC 主导 97.7%，执行/IQ/译码/BPU/RAS 全 Masked**。但存在：① mem_formal 全 Inactive（CHAOSMem 频率 bug，同 8bff9d1 修过的那类）；② 6 个 formal 结果未提交；③ 几乎所有 formal 只跑了 `protection_model=none` 单组、单 fault_model、target_index=0 单 cell —— 与设计文档 §1.2/§2.x C 的网格规格相差甚远；④ F5/F6 子模式（ROB spec_leak、IQ src_ready/tag_sub、LSQFwd fwd_source_sub/phaseOffset、TLB pfn→活页）全部 deferred；⑤ FS 管线（kp920_proxy_fs V110 参数、checkpoint 流水线、PTW H7 formal）未落地。

---

## Phase 1 — 工具正确性 + 在手结果落盘（本分支主题，最高优先）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

1. ✅ 6 个 formal 提交（d4c9e8b）：bpu/decode/ras/iq 全 Masked 384/384；mem 标注无效。
2. ✅ CHAOSMem 频率 bug 修复（b7433dd）：ratio 由时钟频率按 gem5 舍入规则计算（C2→385，C0→500）。真机验证 Tick 精确等于 first_clock×ratio。
3. ✅ mem_formal 重跑（d88dcc7）：**VALID，384/384 Masked，P_SDC=0% [0,1.0]**——DRAM 后备字节被 L1/L2 缓存掩盖（与 L1D 97.7% SDC 对照鲜明）。附带修复 campaign.py --jobs>1 pickle bug（_PoolRep 模块级类；此前所有 formal 都是串行跑的，掩盖了此 bug）。

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

## Phase 2 — protection-aware 第二组（§1.2 核心缺口，改结论级别的补强）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

content.subject: Phase 8.1 — 非 hash oracle(classify/runner/campaign/schema)
content.description: classify_run() 加 oracle_kind 参数(array_hash/per_element_diff/fp_ulp);runner.py GOLDEN_ARRAYS 注册表 + oracle.kind/tol 透传;campaign.py manifest_for_cell() 写 workload.oracle_kind/oracle_tol;manifest.schema.json v2 enum 增补。验收:烟雾 kernel 手工注入验证三种 oracle + reg_chain exact_hash 不变。

content.subject: Phase 8.2 — events_to_skip 均匀采样
content.description: 新 src/cpu/o3/chaos_event_sample.hh:pickSkip(seed,nEligible)=rng%nEligible + countOnlyMode 打印 CHAOS_ELIGIBLE_COUNT。campaign.py dry-run 计数 N_eligible → skip=uniform。六注入器(FPU/Exec/L1DForward/LSQFwd/IQ/ROB)采样切 helper。验收:同 cell 5 seed 注入事件分散 + reg_chain golden 回归。

content.subject: Phase 8.3 — CHAOSCache/CHAOSMem local_mbu 多位档
content.description: faultMask=0 时按 bitsToChange 生成相邻多位掩码;applyProtection() 2-bit(poison/Latent)与 ≥3-bit(SilentEscape)分支走通。验收:secded_poison+bits=2→log Latent;bits=3→SilentEscape。

content.subject: Phase 8.4 — recurring_result_stuck 单故障契约松绑
content.description: runner.py 仅 fault.model==recurring_result_stuck 时允许 max_faults==0;campaign.py 对该模型 cell 发 limits.max_faults=0;schemas 放开。验收:recurring cell 跑通 N>1 损坏+九类结局+Wilson CI;transient cell 仍断言 ∈{0,1}。

content.subject: Phase 8 总验收
content.description: 0a–0d 四项验收 + reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归(exit 0,零 SIGSEGV)。更新 progress.md/task_plan.md。

input.command:

> 依据 `docs/KUNPENG920-故障注入方案详细工程设计.md`（§3.1 阶段表）× 仓库实际进展（HEAD af64ef7 + 未提交 formal 结果）编写。

## Goal

把"每个单元 1 个 cell 的 n=384 formal"推进为设计文档要求的**有意义网格 + protection-aware 对照 + F5/F6 机理模式 + FS 管线**，期间修复已发现的工具正确性 bug（本分支主题），最终产出可信的 §4.1 逃逸分解与 §4.2 保护投资排序。

## 现状一句话总结（详见 findings.md）

S1 四个 P0 单元 + S2/S3 六个 SE 单元 formal 已完成（单 cell × n=384）；核心格局：**乱序后端（PRF/RAT/LSQFwd）DUE 主导 92–100%，存储（L1D）SDC 主导 97.7%，执行/IQ/译码/BPU/RAS 全 Masked**。但存在：① mem_formal 全 Inactive（CHAOSMem 频率 bug，同 8bff9d1 修过的那类）；② 6 个 formal 结果未提交；③ 几乎所有 formal 只跑了 `protection_model=none` 单组、单 fault_model、target_index=0 单 cell —— 与设计文档 §1.2/§2.x C 的网格规格相差甚远；④ F5/F6 子模式（ROB spec_leak、IQ src_ready/tag_sub、LSQFwd fwd_source_sub/phaseOffset、TLB pfn→活页）全部 deferred；⑤ FS 管线（kp920_proxy_fs V110 参数、checkpoint 流水线、PTW H7 formal）未落地。

---

## Phase 1 — 工具正确性 + 在手结果落盘（本分支主题，最高优先）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

1. ✅ 6 个 formal 提交（d4c9e8b）：bpu/decode/ras/iq 全 Masked 384/384；mem 标注无效。
2. ✅ CHAOSMem 频率 bug 修复（b7433dd）：ratio 由时钟频率按 gem5 舍入规则计算（C2→385，C0→500）。真机验证 Tick 精确等于 first_clock×ratio。
3. ✅ mem_formal 重跑（d88dcc7）：**VALID，384/384 Masked，P_SDC=0% [0,1.0]**——DRAM 后备字节被 L1/L2 缓存掩盖（与 L1D 97.7% SDC 对照鲜明）。附带修复 campaign.py --jobs>1 pickle bug（_PoolRep 模块级类；此前所有 formal 都是串行跑的，掩盖了此 bug）。

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

## Phase 2 — protection-aware 第二组（§1.2 核心缺口，改结论级别的补强）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

content.subject: Phase 8.1 — 非 hash oracle(classify/runner/campaign/schema)
content.description: classify_run() 加 oracle_kind 参数(array_hash/per_element_diff/fp_ulp);runner.py GOLDEN_ARRAYS 注册表 + oracle.kind/tol 透传;campaign.py manifest_for_cell() 写 workload.oracle_kind/oracle_tol;manifest.schema.json v2 enum 增补。验收:烟雾 kernel 手工注入验证三种 oracle + reg_chain exact_hash 不变。

content.subject: Phase 8.2 — events_to_skip 均匀采样
content.description: 新 src/cpu/o3/chaos_event_sample.hh:pickSkip(seed,nEligible)=rng%nEligible + countOnlyMode 打印 CHAOS_ELIGIBLE_COUNT。campaign.py dry-run 计数 N_eligible → skip=uniform。六注入器(FPU/Exec/L1DForward/LSQFwd/IQ/ROB)采样切 helper。验收:同 cell 5 seed 注入事件分散 + reg_chain golden 回归。

content.subject: Phase 8.3 — CHAOSCache/CHAOSMem local_mbu 多位档

content.text:
**关键证据拿到**——分散性验证:

| skip | Tick | sn |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 10,795,500 | 13187 |
| 100 | 101,566,500 | 398499 |
| 5000 | 101,566,500 | 398499 |
| 20000 | 101,566,500 | 398499 |
| 40000 | 105,352,000 | 436290 |

skip 0→100 从 sn 13187 跳到 398499:说明前 ~100 个 FP-eligible 事件在 tick 10.8M(输入生成 FMADD 循环)之后,**剩下 40866 个事件全部集中在 tick 101.5M+(ELEMDIFF/ARRAYHASH 的 `ldr q` 向量读回)**——这是烟雾 kernel 自身的指令分布特性(libc 静态链接、FP 事件两段式),不是采样 bug。采样机制工作正常:skip 跨过第一段后按次序消费第二段事件(sn 398499 是第二段第 1 个,29015 才走到 399669,40000 走到 436290——单调推进 ✅)。

用 cholesky(真实 FP workload,FP 事件均匀分布)做正式验收:

input.command:
grep -E "fmadd|fmla" <(objdump -d workloads/directed/cholesky_numeric | head -200) | head -3; # cholesky FP loop is uniform
rm -rf /tmp/p82_chol_count
numactl --cpunodebind=1 --membind=1 -- build/ARM/gem5.opt --quiet -d /tmp/p82_chol_count configs/se/arm_chaos.py --cmd workloads/directed/cholesky_numeric --cpu O3 --chaos_fpu --fpu_first_clock 5000 --fpu_max_faults 1 --fpu_rng_seed 20260825 --fpu_count_only 2>&1 | tail -1; cat /tmp/p82_chol_count/fpu_injections.log

把"每个单元 1 个 cell 的 n=384 formal"推进为设计文档要求的**有意义网格 + protection-aware 对照 + F5/F6 机理模式 + FS 管线**，期间修复已发现的工具正确性 bug（本分支主题），最终产出可信的 §4.1 逃逸分解与 §4.2 保护投资排序。

---

## Phase 1 — 工具正确性 + 在手结果落盘（本分支主题，最高优先）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

1. ✅ 6 个 formal 提交（d4c9e8b）：bpu/decode/ras/iq 全 Masked 384/384；mem 标注无效。
2. ✅ CHAOSMem 频率 bug 修复（b7433dd）：ratio 由时钟频率按 gem5 舍入规则计算（C2→385，C0→500）。真机验证 Tick 精确等于 first_clock×ratio。
3. ✅ mem_formal 重跑（d88dcc7）：**VALID，384/384 Masked，P_SDC=0% [0,1.0]**——DRAM 后备字节被 L1/L2 缓存掩盖（与 L1D 97.7% SDC 对照鲜明）。附带修复 campaign.py --jobs>1 pickle bug（_PoolRep 模块级类；此前所有 formal 都是串行跑的，掩盖了此 bug）。

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

## Phase 2 — protection-aware 第二组（§1.2 核心缺口，改结论级别的补强）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

# cholesky is TINY (~6637 events, 31M ticks). Its FP events also clump: sn 70704 appears for skips 2697..4908 — that's suspicious: skips spanning 2200 events all land on ONE instruction? Unless most of the 6637 events are SQUASHED re-executions of the same insts. Cholesky n=64: 64^3/6 FMADD ≈ 43k... but only 6637 eligible. The sn 70704 might be a hot loop head reached by many dynamic events. Wait — different skips landing on the same sn means the eligible event between skip 2697 and 4908 is THE SAME sn re-executed (squash-reexecute), OR the eligible events are all in a tight loop that retires at one sn... Actually if events are consumed one per call, same sn means the same instruction executed many times? A loop body executes once per iteration with DIFFERENT sn.
# Check: how many distinct sn for consecutive skips — sweep finely:
for skip in 3000 3200 3400 3600 3800 4000 4200 4400 4600 4800; do
rm -rf /tmp/p82_f$skip

done

input.command:
# Single call site. So same sn 70704 for skips 3000-4800 = the "eligible" stream between those skips contains events where... OH WAIT. I see it now:
# `if (pd(rng) > probability) return false;` — probability=1.0 default, so never rejects. 
# The corruption: `if (!ok) return false;` — corrupt FAILS on events whose InstResult is empty/invalid. Those events consumed NO skip (skip already 0) and don't count faults. So after skip exhausts, the FIRST event where corruption succeeds gets the fault. If between event 3000 and event 4800 corruption always FAILS (empty results — e.g. squashed insts), all those runs log the same first-success sn!
# Test: count how many of the 6637 "eligible" events have corruptible results — modify count_only to only count events where corruptFrontResultBlob/corrupt would succeed? That changes semantics: skip counts STREAM events; injection lands on first SUCCESSFUL corrupt after skip exhausted.
# The REAL semantics we want: skip = index into the sequence of CORRUPTIBLE events. The countOnly counter should count the same sequence the injector would corrupt. Fix: in count_only mode, run the corruption check (corruptFrontResultBlob) and only count when it WOULD succeed (then undo — but corruptBlob mutates in place!). Need a non-mutating check: instResult non-empty + blob or scalar.
grep -n "corruptFrontResultBlob\|bool valid\|blob()" CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/inst_res.hh | head -6; sed -n '95,115p' CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/inst_res.hh
input.description: Check InstResult valid/blob accessors for non-mutating test

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

/** v1.1 Phase 8.2: NON-MUTATING check — would corruptFrontResult /
     *  corruptFrontResultBlob succeed on the front result? Used by the
     *  injectors' countOnlyMode so the counted eligible stream is the SAME
     *  stream the corruption path can actually land on (an opClass-eligible
     *  event with an empty InstResult consumes a skip but can never take
     *  the fault — counting it would skew the uniform draw). InstResult's
     *  valid() is private; resultSize()>0 is the public proxy (both
     *  corruptFrontResult* early-return on an empty queue, and an
     *  emplaced result always carries a reg class). */
    bool
    hasCorruptibleResult() const
    {
        return resultSize() > 0;
    }

**机器适配（本机实测 `numactl -H`）**：本 Linux 服务器 126 核（0–127，缺 122/123）、4 NUMA 节点、内存**只挂 node 1**（30 GB；node 0/2/3 size=0）。计划里的 `--cpunodebind=0 --membind=0` 在本机不可行（node 0 无内存）——适配为 **`numactl --cpunodebind=1 --membind=1`**（CPU+内存同 node 1，本机唯一有内存的节点；本机无 cpu179——计划所述故障机是另一台 192 核机，本机即健康机）。复现集 B 用 node 2/3 CPU + node 1 内存。

**实现（6 文件，纯 Python/schema，无 gem5 重建）**：
- `tools/classify.py`：`classify_run()` 增 `oracle_kind`/`oracle_tol`。`array_hash`（比对 kernel 打印的 `ARRAYHASH=<64hex>`）/ `per_element_diff`（`ELEMDIFF n=<count> first=<idx> maxulp=<n>`，count>0→SDC，first/maxulp 进 reason）/ `fp_ulp`（`ULP=<max_ulp_error>`，>tol→SDC、<=tol→Masked——舍入级差异不算损坏）。§9.1 有序类别（SimulatorError/Hang/Crash/Inactive）先于 oracle；只有最终 Masked-vs-SDC 分裂是 oracle 相关。`exact_hash` 默认字节级不变。
- `tools/runner.py`：`GOLDEN_ARRAYS` 注册表（与 `GOLDEN_IDS` 并列）+ `--golden-array` CLI；manifest `oracle.kind`/`oracle.tol`（或 `workload.oracle_kind`/`oracle_tol`）→ `classify_run`；RESULT 行带 `oracle=<kind>`。
- `tools/campaign.py`：`manifest_for_cell()` 写 `workload.oracle_kind`/`oracle_tol` 并镜像进 manifest oracle 块（campaign 未设置时 manifest 与旧版逐字节一致）。

**机器适配（本机实测 `numactl -H`）**：本 Linux 服务器 126 核（0–127，缺 122/123）、4 NUMA 节点、内存**只挂 node 1**（30 GB；node 0/2/3 size=0）。计划里的 `--cpunodebind=0 --membind=0` 在本机不可行（node 0 无内存）——适配为 **`numactl --cpunodebind=1 --membind=1`**（CPU+内存同 node 1，本机唯一有内存的节点；本机无 cpu179——计划所述故障机是另一台 192 核机，本机即健康机）。复现集 B 用 node 2/3 CPU + node 1 内存。

**实现（6 文件，纯 Python/schema，无 gem5 重建）**：
- `tools/classify.py`：`classify_run()` 增 `oracle_kind`/`oracle_tol`。`array_hash`（比对 kernel 打印的 `ARRAYHASH=<64hex>`）/ `per_element_diff`（`ELEMDIFF n=<count> first=<idx> maxulp=<n>`，count>0→SDC，first/maxulp 进 reason）/ `fp_ulp`（`ULP=<max_ulp_error>`，>tol→SDC、<=tol→Masked——舍入级差异不算损坏）。§9.1 有序类别（SimulatorError/Hang/Crash/Inactive）先于 oracle；只有最终 Masked-vs-SDC 分裂是 oracle 相关。`exact_hash` 默认字节级不变。
- `tools/runner.py`：`GOLDEN_ARRAYS` 注册表（与 `GOLDEN_IDS` 并列）+ `--golden-array` CLI；manifest `oracle.kind`/`oracle.tol`（或 `workload.oracle_kind`/`oracle_tol`）→ `classify_run`；RESULT 行带 `oracle=<kind>`。
- `tools/campaign.py`：`manifest_for_cell()` 写 `workload.oracle_kind`/`oracle_tol` 并镜像进 manifest oracle 块（campaign 未设置时 manifest 与旧版逐字节一致）。
- schemas：manifest oracle.kind enum += 3 种 + `oracle.tol`；campaign workload += `oracle_kind`/`oracle_tol`；light validator ORACLE_KINDS 同步。`SELFTEST OK`。

**真机验证（100% 真实输出，NUMA node 1）**：
1. T1 classify 单元测试：24 检查全过（三种 extractor、match/mismatch/缺行、tol 两侧、有序类别优先、exact_hash legacy 含 reg_chain golden 无注入→Inactive）。初版烟雾 kernel 印了 16-hex 被抓出——按规格修为 4-lane FNV 64-hex。
2. T2 烟雾 kernel（elemwise 风格 FMA 载体）：native == gem5 无注入输出（`ARRAYHASH=3d7ac29a...c1739, ELEMDIFF n=0, ULP=0`）。runner array_hash manifest → **Masked** faults_injected=1（GOLDEN_ARRAYS 解析成功）。
3. T2c 真注入 SDC：l1d_fwd first_clock=210000 seed=7（注入 Tick 105001500 addr=0x7e4a8 mask=0x40000000000000，重放两次一致）→ `ELEMDIFF n=1 first=3425 maxulp=18014398509481984`。per_element_diff → **SDC**（reason 带 first/maxulp）；fp_ulp tol=4 → **SDC**；fp_ulp tol=18014398509481985 → **Masked**（tol 两侧验证）。
4. T3 campaign 链：campaign yaml `oracle_kind: fp_ulp oracle_tol: 4` → manifest 双拼写 → runner → SDC，summary `P_SDC=100.0% [20.7,100.0]` n=1。
5. reg_chain golden 回归：**f247ef3fe6f02cfd**，exit=0，无注入日志（exact_hash 路径不变）。

**附带发现（写入 commit note，Phase 9 patch 1a 必须处理）**：CHAOSFPU/CHAOSExec 的 `corruptFrontResult*` 腐蚀的是 `DynInst::instResult` 队列——其**唯一消费者是 checker CPU**（所有配置 `checker=Null`）；AArch64 FP/SIMD 结果经 `getWritableRegOperand`（直接 PRF 指针）落 PRF，整数结果经 `setRegOperand→cpu->setReg→regFile`。**FPU 注入器需在 Phase 9 重写为 PRF-dest 路径**才能让 FSU 故障架构可见（本次烟雾测试用 l1d_fwd 的 packet-XOR 路径，是真实路径）。这解释了首轮 FPU formal 全 Masked 的深层根因（比 v1.1 计划诊断的"故障模型+负载错配"更深一层：**注入点本身架构不可见**）。

4	
5	A campaign expands a Cartesian product of grid axes into immutable per-rep
6	single-fault manifests (max_faults=1), runs each rep via the EXISTING
7	`tools/runner.py` (subprocess), collects the 9-class outcome, and summarizes
8	per-cell Wilson 95% CI (§1.4) + a 5% replay-consistency check (§1.5).
9	
10	THIS DRIVER REUSES runner.py — it does NOT reimplement the manifest->gem5
11	arg mapping, the classifier, or the G5 single-fault assertion. Each rep shells
12	out to `tools/runner.py <manifest.yaml> --binary <bin>` and parses the
13	`RESULT: classification=... faults_injected=... exit=...` stdout line. This is
14	the honest path: one classifier, one mapping, no drift.
15	
16	It is injector-agnostic by construction: any injector already wired into
17	runner.py (gpr/physreg/memory/cache/lsqfwd) is campaignable today. Injectors
18	declared in the schema enum but not yet mapped (rat/rob/iq/...) cause runner.py
19	to reject with a clear error — the driver surfaces that as a SimulatorError

28	  runs/<campaign_id>/<cell_idx>/results.jsonl  (one JSON per rep)

61	def _expand_axis(val):
62	    """A grid axis value is either a scalar or a list-of-scalars. Normalize to
63	    a list of scalars so itertools.product can consume it."""
64	    if isinstance(val, list):
65	        return val

67

70	    """Cartesian product of grid axes. Returns a list of dicts, one per cell:
71	    each dict maps axis-name -> chosen scalar value. Order is deterministic
72	    (Python dict preserves insertion order; itertools.product is ordered).
73	
74	    An axis whose value list is EMPTY is treated as 'no stratification on this
75	    axis' (e.g. bit: [] means 'random mask, no specific bit') — it is dropped

# 下一步计划：鲲鹏920 SDC 故障注入 — S2/S3 收尾 → 网格深化 → F5/F6 → FS → v1.1 补救轮

> 依据 `docs/KUNPENG920-故障注入方案详细工程设计.md`（§3.1 阶段表）× 仓库实际进展（HEAD af64ef7 + 未提交 formal 结果）编写。
> **v1.1 补救轮（Phase 8–12）** 依据工程设计文档 v1.1（§1.3 故障模型必跑矩阵 + §1.7 负载/oracle 纪律 + §2.3/2.6/2.8/2.17）× `KUNPENG920-v1.1补救轮执行计划.md`；落地仓库 `gem5-fi/`（分支 `fix/fi-tool-correctness`，真 HEAD `4bf8d0d` = 238 commits）。
> 本计划是**工作计划**；证据审计结论见 `findings.md`。

## Goal

把"每个单元 1 个 cell 的 n=384 formal"推进为设计文档要求的**有意义网格 + protection-aware 对照 + F5/F6 机理模式 + FS 管线**，期间修复已发现的工具正确性 bug（本分支主题），最终产出可信的 §4.1 逃逸分解与 §4.2 保护投资排序。

## 现状一句话总结（详见 findings.md）

S1 四个 P0 单元 + S2/S3 六个 SE 单元 formal 已完成（单 cell × n=384）；核心格局：**乱序后端（PRF/RAT/LSQFwd）DUE 主导 92–100%，存储（L1D）SDC 主导 97.7%，执行/IQ/译码/BPU/RAS 全 Masked**。但存在：① mem_formal 全 Inactive（CHAOSMem 频率 bug，同 8bff9d1 修过的那类）；② 6 个 formal 结果未提交；③ 几乎所有 formal 只跑了 `protection_model=none` 单组、单 fault_model、target_index=0 单 cell —— 与设计文档 §1.2/§2.x C 的网格规格相差甚远；④ F5/F6 子模式（ROB spec_leak、IQ src_ready/tag_sub、LSQFwd fwd_source_sub/phaseOffset、TLB pfn→活页）全部 deferred；⑤ FS 管线（kp920_proxy_fs V110 参数、checkpoint 流水线、PTW H7 formal）未落地。

---

## Phase 1 — 工具正确性 + 在手结果落盘（本分支主题，最高优先）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

1. ✅ 6 个 formal 提交（d4c9e8b）：bpu/decode/ras/iq 全 Masked 384/384；mem 标注无效。
2. ✅ CHAOSMem 频率 bug 修复（b7433dd）：ratio 由时钟频率按 gem5 舍入规则计算（C2→385，C0→500）。真机验证 Tick 精确等于 first_clock×ratio。
3. ✅ mem_formal 重跑（d88dcc7）：**VALID，384/384 Masked，P_SDC=0% [0,1.0]**——DRAM 后备字节被 L1/L2 缓存掩盖（与 L1D 97.7% SDC 对照鲜明）。附带修复 campaign.py --jobs>1 pickle bug（_PoolRep 模块级类；此前所有 formal 都是串行跑的，掩盖了此 bug）。

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

## Phase 2 — protection-aware 第二组（§1.2 核心缺口，改结论级别的补强）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**


===END-PWF-DATA kind=plan nonce=f45079ceaf3f7e79b49975f3===

content.text: 零新警告。提交 Phase 8.2(补丁 2):

input.command:
git add CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/chaos_event_sample.hh CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSFPU/ CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSExec/ CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSIQ/ CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSL1DForward/ CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSLSQFwd/ CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/dyn_inst.hh configs/se/arm_chaos.py tools/campaign.py tools/runner.py schemas/campaign.schema.json schemas/manifest.schema.json && git commit -m "feat: v1.1 Phase 8.2 uniform events_to_skip sampling — chaos_event_sample.hh + countOnly + 5-injector wiring + campaign dry-run

Problem (design doc §1.7 rule 4): every hook-on-event injector drew
events_to_skip ~ geometric(p=0.1) — mean 10, P(skip<=30)~=96% — so the
single maxFaults=1 fault landed in the FIRST ~30 eligible events of the
ROI for nearly every rep, not the eligible-event distribution.

Fix (two pieces, per task_plan Phase 8.2):
- cpu/o3/chaos_event_sample.hh (new, header-only): chaosPickSkip(seed,
  n_eligible) = one LCG round % n — a seed-derived UNIFORM draw over the
  eligible events. No SConscript entry needed (cpu/o3 is on CPPPATH).
- countOnlyMode: the injector consumes eligible events without
  corrupting and prints CHAOS_ELIGIBLE_COUNT=<n> via registerExitCallback
  (the destructor never fires on gem5's exit path — found by real test).
- Six injectors wired (FPU/Exec/L1DForward/LSQFwd/IQ per the plan; ROB
  has no events_to_skip — its spec_leak sampling lives in CHAOSRenameMap
  and consumes squashes, a different event family): eventsToSkip param
  (UInt64, UINT64_MAX sentinel = legacy geometric draw, byte-identical
  replays) + countOnly param (Bool) + config CLI flags (--{iq,exec,fpu,
  l1dfwd,lsq}_events_to_skip / --*_count_only) + runner.py manifest
  sampling.{events_to_skip,count_only} routing + campaign.py
  workload.uniform_sampling (per-cell countOnly dry-run -> per-rep
  chaos_pick_skip, the Python twin of the C++ helper) + schemas.

Correctness fix found DURING verification (the cholesky dispersion
test): skip must index the stream the corruption can actually land on.
cholesky has 6637 opClass-eligible FSU events but only 32 carry a
corruptible InstResult (empty/invalid results can consume a skip but
never take the fault). DynInst::hasCorruptibleResult() (non-mutating,
!instResult.empty()) added; FPU/Exec countOnly counts and fixed-skip
consumes ONLY corruptible events (legacy geometric mode keeps the old
consume-on-eligible behavior for byte-identical replays). This also
QUANTIFIES the Phase 8.1 finding: on cholesky 99.5% of 'FSU injections'
were landing on dead results.

Real-machine verification (NUMA node 1, all real output):
1. countOnly: cholesky fsu CHAOS_ELIGIBLE_COUNT=32; smoke kernel 40966.
2. 5-seed dispersion (cholesky, fixed skips 4/5/11/18/23): injection
   sn=13051/13142/74271/90962/96782, ticks 10.8M-25.6M — five DIFFERENT
   dynamic instructions, uniformly spread (vs one fixed instruction
   under the old geometric head-clustering).
3. Legacy path unchanged: l1dfwd seed 7 replay is byte-identical
   (Tick 105001500 addr=0x7e4a8 mask=0x40000000000000); FPU seeds 1/2/3
   masks identical to pre-patch (0x40000000000000/0x100/0x8) — RNG
   stream not perturbed. (FPU sn/tick moved ~46 cycles vs pre-patch
   logs because the smoke kernel BINARY itself changed between rounds
   — ARRAYHASH 16->64 hex — not an injector behavior change.)
4. campaign end-to-end (uniform_sampling: true, n=5): 'cell 0:
   N_eligible=32 (countOnly dry-run)', per-rep manifests carry
   events_to_skip 4/5/11/18/23, all 5 reps faults_injected=1 with
   distinct injection sn on replay. Legacy campaign (no
   uniform_sampling) writes no sampling block; both manifest flavors
   pass the light validator 5/5.
5. reg_chain golden regression: f247ef3fe6f02cfd exit=0.
6. Rebuild clean: zero new warnings (only pre-existing
   CHAOSArmSysReg tps unused-variable from ba27677, untouched here).

Also fixed pre-commit: campaign.py main() used undefined 'wl' for
uniform_sampling lookup (NameError on first run) -> campaign['workload']." && git log --oneline -1

## 现状一句话总结（详见 findings.md）

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

# Acceptance: CHAOSCache secded_poison, bits_to_change=2 -> log "bits=2 -> Latent"; bits=3 -> SilentEscape
for bits in 2 3; do
echo "=== l1d secded_poison bits=$bits ==="
rm -rf /tmp/p83_b$bits
numactl --cpunodebind=1 --membind=1 -- build/ARM/gem5.opt --quiet -d /tmp/p83_b$bits configs/se/arm_chaos_cache.py --cmd workloads/directed/l1d_reduce --cpu O3 --target l1d --first_clock 20000 --max_faults 1 --rng_seed 20260825 --fault_type bit_flip --protection_model secded_poison --bits_to_change $bits > /dev/null 2>&1
grep -E "Mask:|protection:" /tmp/p83_b$bits/cache_injections.log | head -4
done

firstClock=args.first_clock,
        lastClock=args.last_clock,
        maxFaults=args.max_faults,
        rngSeed=args.rng_seed,
        writeLog=True,
    )
    board.chaos_phys = chaos_p

if args.chaos_mem:
    # G4: attach CHAOSMem to the DRAM AbstractMemory. The stdlib
    # SingleChannelDDR3_1600 exposes its dram interface via mem_ctrl[0].dram
    # (DRAMInterface is an AbstractMemory subclass, so access()/getAddrRange()
    # are available). This is backing-store byte injection only — NOT a
    # timing DRAM/controller/ECC path (per plan §2.2).
    dram = memory.mem_ctrl[0].dram
    # Frequency-correct cycles->ticks ratio (same fix as kp920_proxy.py):
    # firstClock is in CPU cycles; the old hardcoded tickToClockRatio=1000
    # assumed 1GHz. C0 is 2GHz -> period 500 ticks, so the old value opened
    # the window at 2x the requested cycle count. Compute from the board
    # clock exactly as gem5 rounds it (Tick=1ps, Decimal ROUND_HALF_UP —
    # m5/ticks.py:80). (clk_domain.clock.getValue() can't be used here: the
    # global frequency isn't fixed until m5.instantiate().)
    import decimal
    _ratio = int(decimal.Decimal((1.0 / 2e9) * 1e12)
                 .to_integral_value(decimal.ROUND_HALF_UP))
    print(f"[arm_chaos] CHAOSMem tickToClockRatio={_ratio} "
          f"(board 2GHz, was hardcoded 1000)")
    board.chaos_mem = CHAOSMem(
        mem=dram,
        probability=args.probability,
        firstClock=args.first_clock,
        lastClock=0,
        faultType=args.fault_type,
        # CHAOSMem parses faultMask as BINARY (std::stoi(..., 2)), so "0" means
        # random mask. Pass --fault_mask through as an 8-char binary string so

an ADJACENT (contiguous) n-bit burst at a random start — the physical
MBU model (adjacent-cell upset, single particle strike) — so
popcount(mask) == bits_to_change exactly and every ladder rung is
reachable.

Two latent config bugs found and fixed during the acceptance run
(both real-machine crashes/wrong outputs):
1. arm_chaos.py used args.addr_map_sub without defining the argparse
   flag (Phase 4.6 added it to kp920_proxy.py only) — EVERY --chaos_mem
   run on C0 died with AttributeError before this fix.

   the SimObject default (-1) drew a random 1..8 bits per rep, so

   cholesky): bits=1 -> 'Mask: 0x40 ... bits=1 -> Corrected'
   (1-bit undo regression intact); bits=2 -> 'Mask: 0x60 ...
   bits=2 -> Latent'; bits=3 -> 'Mask: 0x70 ... bits=3 ->
   SilentEscape'. Adjacent masks, popcount exact.
3. reg_chain golden regression: f247ef3fe6f02cfd, exit=0.
4. Rebuild clean (zero new warnings)." && git log --oneline -1 && git push origin fix/fi-tool-correctness 2>&1 | tail -1

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

# ---- runner.py: two sites ----
p = "tools/runner.py"
s = open(p).read()

# site 1: the manifest max_faults assertion
old = '''    assert m["limits"]["max_faults"] in (0,1), "formal runs require max_faults in {0,1}"'''
new = '''    # G5 single-fault contract. v1.1 Phase 8.4 (task_plan 0d): the
    # recurring_result_stuck model is EXEMPT — it is a PERMANENT fault
    # (every opClass-eligible FSU result gets the same fixed mask, modeling
    # a stuck multiplier partial-product bit) and runs with max_faults=0
    # (unlimited). Everything else still requires max_faults in {0,1}.
    _recurring = (m["fault"]["model"] == "recurring_result_stuck")
    if _recurring:
        if m["limits"]["max_faults"] != 0:
            sys.exit("[runner] fault.model=recurring_result_stuck requires "
                     "limits.max_faults==0 (the fault recurs on every "
                     "eligible event). Aborting.")
        print("[runner] recurring_result_stuck: single-fault contract "
              "relaxed (max_faults=0, recurring permanent fault)")
    else:
        assert m["limits"]["max_faults"] in (0,1), "formal runs require max_faults in {0,1}"'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, new)

# site 2: the G5 faults-not-in-{0,1} violation print — recurring runs may
# legitimately log N>1 corruptions; keep the honest log but don't mislabel.
old = '''    # G5 assertion: exactly 0 or 1 valid injection
    if faults not in (0,1):
        print(f"[runner] G5 VIOLATION: faults_injected={faults} (not in {{0,1}}) "
              f"— run invalid")'''
new = '''    # G5 assertion: exactly 0 or 1 valid injection — EXCEPT the v1.1
    # Phase 8.4 recurring_result_stuck model, whose permanent fault
    # legitimately corrupts every eligible event (N>1 by design).
    if faults not in (0,1) and not _recurring:
        print(f"[runner] G5 VIOLATION: faults_injected={faults} (not in {{0,1}}) "
              f"— run invalid")
    if _recurring:
        print(f"[runner] recurring model: faults_injected={faults} "
              f"(N>1 expected for the permanent recurring fault)")'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p, "w").write(s)
print("runner.py patched (2 sites)")

7	A v2 schema FILE alone is therefore useless here — it would be silently
8	skipped at runtime, defeating §1.6. This validator is the runtime ENFORCER:
9	it checks the subset of constraints runner.py actually relies on (required
10	keys, enum values, basic types) so a malformed or v2-but-unmapped manifest is
11	caught BEFORE gem5 runs. When jsonschema IS available (healthy machine or
12	future install), runner.py prefers it (full draft-07 enforcement); this is the
13	honest fallback that makes §1.6 enforced on every host.

16	constraints as a frozen snapshot of the JSON schema's enforcement-relevant
17	subset. The JSON schema file (schemas/manifest.schema.json) stays as the
18	machine-readable, interoperable artifact; this module is the runtime spec of
19	what runner.py checks. A self-test (_selftest, run via `python3 -m
20	tools.manifest_validate`) keeps the two in sync against the sample manifests.
21	
22	Usage:
23	  from tools.manifest_validate import validate
24	  ok, errs = validate(manifest_dict)
25	  if not ok: sys.exit("manifest validation FAILED: " + "; ".join(errs))
26	"""
27	import os, sys, json, yaml

43	                          "exmon", "ras")

45	COMPONENTS_V2_DECLARED = ("l1_tlb", "l2_tlb", "sysreg", "ptw",
46	                          "l3", "noc", "coherence", "memctrl")
47	FAULT_MODELS = ("transient_bit_flip", "local_mbu", "intermittent_burst",

49	                "delay_omission",

58	
59	REQUIRED_TOP = ("schema_version", "run_id", "source", "platform", "workload",
60	                "trigger", "target", "fault", "rng", "limits")
61	REQUIRED_SOURCE = ("chaos_commit", "gem5_commit")
62	REQUIRED_PLATFORM = ("isa", "mode", "cpu_model", "config_family")
63	REQUIRED_WORKLOAD = ("binary_sha256",)
64	REQUIRED_TRIGGER = ("mode", "value")

67	REQUIRED_RNG = ("master_seed", "selection_seed")

71	def _is_int(v):

73	    # valid max_faults integer).

75

77	def _check_enum(val, allowed, path, errs):

81

83	    for k in reqs:

87

129	        if "value" in t and not _is_int(t["value"]):

131	        if "value" in t and _is_int(t["value"]) and t["value"] < 0:

# 下一步计划：鲲鹏920 SDC 故障注入 — S2/S3 收尾 → 网格深化 → F5/F6 → FS → v1.1 补救轮

> 依据 `docs/KUNPENG920-故障注入方案详细工程设计.md`（§3.1 阶段表）× 仓库实际进展（HEAD af64ef7 + 未提交 formal 结果）编写。
> **v1.1 补救轮（Phase 8–12）** 依据工程设计文档 v1.1（§1.3 故障模型必跑矩阵 + §1.7 负载/oracle 纪律 + §2.3/2.6/2.8/2.17）× `KUNPENG920-v1.1补救轮执行计划.md`；落地仓库 `gem5-fi/`（分支 `fix/fi-tool-correctness`，真 HEAD `4bf8d0d` = 238 commits）。
> 本计划是**工作计划**；证据审计结论见 `findings.md`。

## Goal

把"每个单元 1 个 cell 的 n=384 formal"推进为设计文档要求的**有意义网格 + protection-aware 对照 + F5/F6 机理模式 + FS 管线**，期间修复已发现的工具正确性 bug（本分支主题），最终产出可信的 §4.1 逃逸分解与 §4.2 保护投资排序。

## 现状一句话总结（详见 findings.md）

S1 四个 P0 单元 + S2/S3 六个 SE 单元 formal 已完成（单 cell × n=384）；核心格局：**乱序后端（PRF/RAT/LSQFwd）DUE 主导 92–100%，存储（L1D）SDC 主导 97.7%，执行/IQ/译码/BPU/RAS 全 Masked**。但存在：① mem_formal 全 Inactive（CHAOSMem 频率 bug，同 8bff9d1 修过的那类）；② 6 个 formal 结果未提交；③ 几乎所有 formal 只跑了 `protection_model=none` 单组、单 fault_model、target_index=0 单 cell —— 与设计文档 §1.2/§2.x C 的网格规格相差甚远；④ F5/F6 子模式（ROB spec_leak、IQ src_ready/tag_sub、LSQFwd fwd_source_sub/phaseOffset、TLB pfn→活页）全部 deferred；⑤ FS 管线（kp920_proxy_fs V110 参数、checkpoint 流水线、PTW H7 formal）未落地。

---

## Phase 1 — 工具正确性 + 在手结果落盘（本分支主题，最高优先）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

1. ✅ 6 个 formal 提交（d4c9e8b）：bpu/decode/ras/iq 全 Masked 384/384；mem 标注无效。
2. ✅ CHAOSMem 频率 bug 修复（b7433dd）：ratio 由时钟频率按 gem5 舍入规则计算（C2→385，C0→500）。真机验证 Tick 精确等于 first_clock×ratio。
3. ✅ mem_formal 重跑（d88dcc7）：**VALID，384/384 Masked，P_SDC=0% [0,1.0]**——DRAM 后备字节被 L1/L2 缓存掩盖（与 L1D 97.7% SDC 对照鲜明）。附带修复 campaign.py --jobs>1 pickle bug（_PoolRep 模块级类；此前所有 formal 都是串行跑的，掩盖了此 bug）。

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

## Phase 2 — protection-aware 第二组（§1.2 核心缺口，改结论级别的补强）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

content.subject: Phase 8.1 — 非 hash oracle(classify/runner/campaign/schema)
content.description: classify_run() 加 oracle_kind 参数(array_hash/per_element_diff/fp_ulp);runner.py GOLDEN_ARRAYS 注册表 + oracle.kind/tol 透传;campaign.py manifest_for_cell() 写 workload.oracle_kind/oracle_tol;manifest.schema.json v2 enum 增补。验收:烟雾 kernel 手工注入验证三种 oracle + reg_chain exact_hash 不变。

content.subject: Phase 8.2 — events_to_skip 均匀采样
content.description: 新 src/cpu/o3/chaos_event_sample.hh:pickSkip(seed,nEligible)=rng%nEligible + countOnlyMode 打印 CHAOS_ELIGIBLE_COUNT。campaign.py dry-run 计数 N_eligible → skip=uniform。六注入器(FPU/Exec/L1DForward/LSQFwd/IQ/ROB)采样切 helper。验收:同 cell 5 seed 注入事件分散 + reg_chain golden 回归。

content.subject: Phase 8.3 — CHAOSCache/CHAOSMem local_mbu 多位档
content.description: faultMask=0 时按 bitsToChange 生成相邻多位掩码;applyProtection() 2-bit(poison/Latent)与 ≥3-bit(SilentEscape)分支走通。验收:secded_poison+bits=2→log Latent;bits=3→SilentEscape。

content.subject: Phase 8.4 — recurring_result_stuck 单故障契约松绑
content.description: runner.py 仅 fault.model==recurring_result_stuck 时允许 max_faults==0;campaign.py 对该模型 cell 发 limits.max_faults=0;schemas 放开。验收:recurring cell 跑通 N>1 损坏+九类结局+Wilson CI;transient cell 仍断言 ∈{0,1}。

content.subject: Phase 8 总验收
content.description: 0a–0d 四项验收 + reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归(exit 0,零 SIGSEGV)。更新 progress.md/task_plan.md。

input.command:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p = "tools/runner.py"
s = open(p).read()
old = '''                 "legal_domain_sub": "bit_flip",
                 "delay_omission": "bit_flip"}'''
new = '''                 "legal_domain_sub": "bit_flip",
                 "delay_omission": "bit_flip",
                 # v1.1 Phase 8.4: recurring permanent fault — same fixed
                 # mask on EVERY eligible event (max_faults=0 = unlimited;
                 # the dedicated CHAOSFPU recurring MODE lands in Phase 9
                 # patch 1a; until then the unlimited-fault bit_flip path
                 # carries the contract, with the recurring pairing check
                 # above enforcing max_faults==0).
                 "recurring_result_stuck": "bit_flip"}'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
open(p, "w").write(s.replace(old, new))
print("model_map updated")
PYEOF

# Design the PRF-dest rewrite. DynInst::execute hook has the dyn_inst; the PRF dest is reached via
# cpu->getWritableReg(renamedDestIdx(0)) for VecRegClass (blob path — returns void* to the VecRegContainer
# inside the PRF), or cpu->setReg for scalars. Key subtlety: getWritableRegOperand is called DURING
# staticInst->execute() (the AA64FpDest write-back); our hook runs AFTER it — the result is already in
# the PRF. So corrupting the PRF dest post-execute is equivalent and simplest:
#   for each dest reg i: reg = dyn_inst->renamedDestIdx(i);
#     if VecRegClass/FloatRegClass → uint8_t *p = (uint8_t*)cpu->getWritableReg(reg); XOR first 8 bytes
#     if IntRegClass (scalar FP stored as RegVal) → cpu->setReg(reg, cpu->getReg(reg) ^ mask)
# Check DynInst accessors available:
grep -n "renamedDestIdx\|getWritableReg\b\|RegVal getReg" CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/dyn_inst.hh | head -8

4 seeds 里 2 SDC / 2 Masked——FSU 故障首次在这个工具链上产生真实结局分布。这正是首轮 "FPU 0% SDC" 伪影被修正的直接证据。补 golden 回归 + 更广验证(烟雾 kernel ELEMDIFF 路径),然后提交:

echo "---smoke kernel ELEMDIFF path (l1dfwd fc=210000 was n=1; now try fpu at check loop)---"
for seed in 3 5; do
rm -rf /tmp/p9a_sm$seed
out=$(numactl --cpunodebind=1 --membind=1 -- build/ARM/gem5.opt --quiet -d /tmp/p9a_sm$seed configs/se/arm_chaos.py --cmd /tmp/oracle_smoke_kernel --cpu O3 --chaos_fpu --fpu_first_clock 210000 --fpu_max_faults 1 --fpu_rng_seed $seed 2>&1 | grep -E "ELEMDIFF|ULP" | tr '\n' ' ')

input.command:
git add CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSFPU/CHAOSFPU.cc && git commit -m "fix: v1.1 Phase 9 patch 1a-0 — CHAOSFPU corruption rewritten to the PRF-dest path (architecturally visible FSU faults)

Root cause (found in Phase 8.1/8.2, quantified during 8.2): the old
corruptFrontResult*/corruptFrontResultBlob XORed the DynInst::instResult
queue, whose ONLY consumer is the checker CPU (checker=Null in every
CHAOS config). AArch64 FP/SIMD results reach the PRF via
getWritableRegOperand (a direct PRF pointer consumed DURING
staticInst->execute) and never touch instResult — the FSU fault was
architecturally INVISIBLE. On cholesky, 6637 opClass-eligible events
carried only 32 InstResults and zero checksum effects: the first-round
'FPU 0% SDC' formal measured a dead path, not the FSU.

Rewrite: post-execute, XOR the physical destination register's PRF
storage directly — VecRegClass (all AArch64 FP/SIMD regs) via
cpu->getWritableReg(dest) (low 8 bytes), FloatRegClass/VecElemClass via
cpu->getReg/setReg. Int/cond/misc dests remain CHAOSExec's scope. The
Phase 8.2 countOnly/fixed-skip stream switched to the matching
dest-based check ('inst has an FP/vector dest reg', no InstResult
involved) so count/skip index exactly the corruptible stream.

Real-machine verification (NUMA node 1, all real output; cholesky,
first_clock=5000, max_faults=1):
- seed 20260825: checksum 2d853a3c6fbef5a9 != golden 37621bc0a633976f
  -> SDC (injection sn=13799 mask=0x4)
- seed 20260827: checksum eeecdb9ddfcd0012 != golden -> SDC
- seed 20260826/20260828: checksum == golden -> Masked (REAL masking —
  fault landed but was overwritten/unconsumed — no longer a dead-path
  artifact)
2 SDC / 2 Masked out of 4 seeds: the FSU fault now produces a genuine
outcome distribution. This is the direct correction of the first-round
'FPU 0% SDC' artifact and the prerequisite for the Phase 9 six-mode
work (bitseg/fma_intermediate/recurring/rounding_sub/f3_data_dependent/
fpsr_suppress — all of them ride this path).

(zero new warnings)." && git push origin fix/fi-tool-correctness 2>&1 | tail -1

python3 - <<'PYEOF'
# mode 2: fma_intermediate — method3-matched weighted field distribution
p = "CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSFPU/CHAOSFPU.py"
s = open(p).read()
old = '''    bitseg = Param.String("", "FP bit segment: sign | exp_hi | exp_lo | "
                              "mant_hi | mant_mid | mant_lo ('' = uniform)")'''
new = '''    bitseg = Param.String("", "FP bit segment: sign | exp_hi | exp_lo | "
                              "mant_hi | mant_mid | mant_lo ('' = uniform)")
    # v1.1 Phase 9 patch 1a mode 2 — fma_intermediate (E3 BEHAVIORAL
    # PROXY, not a microarchitectural replay): gem5's ARM FP is a pure
    # functional model (arch/arm/fplib.cc fplibMulAdd) with no real
    # alignment-shift/partial-product/normalization hardware, so the
    # pre-rounding FMA intermediate cannot be reached. Plan fallback (b):
    # draw the flip bit from a method3-matched weighted field
    # distribution on the FINAL result — mant 85% / exp 10% / sign 5%,
    # with the mantissa draw uniform over its 52 bits. The doc records
    # this as an E3 behavioral proxy.
    fmaWeighted = Param.Bool(False, "fma_intermediate mode: weighted "
                                    "field draw (mant 85% / exp 10% / "
                                    "sign 5%) on the final result")'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
open(p, "w").write(s.replace(old, new))
print("py patched")

# hh member
p = "CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSFPU/CHAOSFPU.hh"
s = open(p).read()
old = '''    // v1.1 Phase 9 patch 1a mode 1 — bitseg field (empty = uniform).
    std::string bitseg;'''
new = '''    // v1.1 Phase 9 patch 1a mode 1 — bitseg field (empty = uniform).
    std::string bitseg;
    // mode 2 — fma_intermediate weighted proxy (E3).
    bool fma_weighted = false;'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
open(p, "w").write(s.replace(old, new))
print("hh patched")

# cc: ctor init + mask draw
p = "CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSFPU/CHAOSFPU.cc"
s = open(p).read()
old = '''          write_log(p.writeLog),
          bitseg(p.bitseg)
    {'''
new = '''          write_log(p.writeLog),
          bitseg(p.bitseg),
          fma_weighted(p.fmaWeighted)
    {'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, new)

old = '''        RegVal mask;
        if (fault_mask) {
            mask = fault_mask;
        } else if (!bitseg.empty()) {'''
new = '''        RegVal mask;
        if (fault_mask) {
            mask = fault_mask;
        } else if (fma_weighted) {
            // v1.1 Phase 9 mode 2 — fma_intermediate (E3 behavioral
            // proxy, plan fallback (b)): draw the field from method3's
            // matched distribution (mant 85% / exp 10% / sign 5%), then
            // the bit uniformly within the field. Implemented as the
            // mant_* / exp_* / sign bitseg ranges.
            int lo, hi;
            unsigned field = (unsigned)(rng() % 100);
            if (field < 85)      { lo = 0;  hi = 51; }  // mantissa (52 bits)
            else if (field < 95) { lo = 52; hi = 62; }  // exponent (11 bits)
            else                 { lo = 63; hi = 63; }  // sign
            int bit = lo + (int)(rng() % (unsigned)(hi - lo + 1));
            mask = (1ULL << bit);
        } else if (!bitseg.empty()) {'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, new)

# log line: mark the mode
old = '''                << (bitseg.empty() ? std::string() : ", bitseg=" + bitseg)'''
new = '''                << (bitseg.empty() ? std::string() : ", bitseg=" + bitseg)
                << (fma_weighted ? ", mode=fma_intermediate" : "")'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p, "w").write(s)
print("cc patched")

input.command:
# Acceptance for mode 2: distribution check — 20 seeds, count field hits (expect ~85% mant / ~10% exp / ~5% sign)
for seed in $(seq 201 220); do
rm -rf /tmp/p9c_$seed
numactl --cpunodebind=1 --membind=1 -- build/ARM/gem5.opt --quiet -d /tmp/p9c_$seed configs/se/arm_chaos.py --cmd workloads/directed/cholesky_numeric --cpu O3 --chaos_fpu --fpu_first_clock 5000 --fpu_max_faults 1 --fpu_rng_seed $seed --fpu_fma_weighted > /dev/null 2>&1
grep -o "mask=0x[0-9a-f]*" /tmp/p9c_$seed/fpu_injections.log 2>/dev/null | head -1
done | python3 -c "
import sys
mant=exp=sign=0
for line in sys.stdin:
    m = int(line.strip().split('=')[1], 16)
    if m >> 63: sign += 1
    elif (m >> 52) & 0x7ff: exp += 1
    else: mant += 1
t = mant+exp+sign
print(f'mant={mant}/{t} ({100*mant/t:.0f}%)  exp={exp}/{t}  sign={sign}/{t}')"
input.description: Mode 2 acceptance: weighted distribution over 20 seeds

> **v1.1 补救轮（Phase 8–12）** 依据工程设计文档 v1.1（§1.3 故障模型必跑矩阵 + §1.7 负载/oracle 纪律 + §2.3/2.6/2.8/2.17）× `KUNPENG920-v1.1补救轮执行计划.md`；落地仓库 `gem5-fi/`（分支 `fix/fi-tool-correctness`，真 HEAD `4bf8d0d` = 238 commits）。

把"每个单元 1 个 cell 的 n=384 formal"推进为设计文档要求的**有意义网格 + protection-aware 对照 + F5/F6 机理模式 + FS 管线**，期间修复已发现的工具正确性 bug（本分支主题），最终产出可信的 §4.1 逃逸分解与 §4.2 保护投资排序。

## 现状一句话总结（详见 findings.md）

S1 四个 P0 单元 + S2/S3 六个 SE 单元 formal 已完成（单 cell × n=384）；核心格局：**乱序后端（PRF/RAT/LSQFwd）DUE 主导 92–100%，存储（L1D）SDC 主导 97.7%，执行/IQ/译码/BPU/RAS 全 Masked**。但存在：① mem_formal 全 Inactive（CHAOSMem 频率 bug，同 8bff9d1 修过的那类）；② 6 个 formal 结果未提交；③ 几乎所有 formal 只跑了 `protection_model=none` 单组、单 fault_model、target_index=0 单 cell —— 与设计文档 §1.2/§2.x C 的网格规格相差甚远；④ F5/F6 子模式（ROB spec_leak、IQ src_ready/tag_sub、LSQFwd fwd_source_sub/phaseOffset、TLB pfn→活页）全部 deferred；⑤ FS 管线（kp920_proxy_fs V110 参数、checkpoint 流水线、PTW H7 formal）未落地。

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

1. ✅ 6 个 formal 提交（d4c9e8b）：bpu/decode/ras/iq 全 Masked 384/384；mem 标注无效。
2. ✅ CHAOSMem 频率 bug 修复（b7433dd）：ratio 由时钟频率按 gem5 舍入规则计算（C2→385，C0→500）。真机验证 Tick 精确等于 first_clock×ratio。
3. ✅ mem_formal 重跑（d88dcc7）：**VALID，384/384 Masked，P_SDC=0% [0,1.0]**——DRAM 后备字节被 L1/L2 缓存掩盖（与 L1D 97.7% SDC 对照鲜明）。附带修复 campaign.py --jobs>1 pickle bug（_PoolRep 模块级类；此前所有 formal 都是串行跑的，掩盖了此 bug）。

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

content.text: 模式 3：**recurring_result_stuck** — 相同的固定掩码，在每个符合条件的 FSU 结果上（跳过机制禁用，maxFaults=0）。一旦掩码确定，它就会固定下来：

input.command:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
# mode 3: recurring_result_stuck
p = "CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSFPU/CHAOSFPU.py"
s = open(p).read()
old = '''    fmaWeighted = Param.Bool(False, "fma_intermediate mode: weighted "
                                    "field draw (mant 85% / exp 10% / "
                                    "sign 5%) on the final result")'''
new = '''    fmaWeighted = Param.Bool(False, "fma_intermediate mode: weighted "
                                    "field draw (mant 85% / exp 10% / "
                                    "sign 5%) on the final result")
    # v1.1 Phase 9 patch 1a mode 3 — recurring_result_stuck: the SAME
    # fixed mask is applied to EVERY opClass-eligible FSU result (modeling
    # a stuck multiplier partial-product bit — the literature's dominant
    # execution-unit SDC source). The mask is drawn once (first eligible
    # event) and reused. Runs with maxFaults=0 (unlimited; the Phase 8.4
    # runner contract enforces the pairing). Skip consumption is disabled
    # in this mode (every event is hit).
    recurringStuck = Param.Bool(False, "recurring_result_stuck mode: same "
                                       "fixed mask on every eligible result")'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
open(p, "w").write(s.replace(old, new))
print("py patched")

p = "CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSFPU/CHAOSFPU.hh"
s = open(p).read()
old = '''    // mode 2 — fma_intermediate weighted proxy (E3).
    bool fma_weighted = false;'''
new = '''    // mode 2 — fma_intermediate weighted proxy (E3).
    bool fma_weighted = false;
    // mode 3 — recurring_result_stuck: same fixed mask every event.
    bool recurring_stuck = false;
    uint64_t recurring_mask = 0;      // drawn once on the first event
    bool recurring_mask_drawn = false;'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
open(p, "w").write(s.replace(old, new))
print("hh patched")

p = "CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSFPU/CHAOSFPU.cc"
s = open(p).read()
old = '''          bitseg(p.bitseg),
          fma_weighted(p.fmaWeighted)
    {'''
new = '''          bitseg(p.bitseg),
          fma_weighted(p.fmaWeighted),
          recurring_stuck(p.recurringStuck)
    {'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, new)

# mask draw: recurring draws once, reuses
old = '''        RegVal mask;
        if (fault_mask) {
            mask = fault_mask;
        } else if (fma_weighted) {'''
new = '''        RegVal mask;
        if (recurring_stuck) {
            // v1.1 Phase 9 mode 3 — the SAME fixed mask every event: the
            // directed --fault_mask if given, else drawn once from the
            // uniform pick and reused for the whole run.
            if (!recurring_mask_drawn) {
                recurring_mask = fault_mask ? fault_mask
                                            : (1ULL << (rng() % 64));
                recurring_mask_drawn = true;
            }
            mask = recurring_mask;
        } else if (fault_mask) {
            mask = fault_mask;
        } else if (fma_weighted) {'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, new)

# log line marker
old = '''                << (fma_weighted ? ", mode=fma_intermediate" : "")'''
new = '''                << (fma_weighted ? ", mode=fma_intermediate" : "")
                << (recurring_stuck ? ", mode=recurring_result_stuck" : "")'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p, "w").write(s)
print("cc patched")

# config CLI + instantiation
p = "configs/se/arm_chaos.py"
s = open(p).read()
old = '''p.add_argument("--fpu_fma_weighted", action="store_true",
               help="v1.1 Phase 9: fma_intermediate proxy — draw the flip "
                    "bit from method3's matched weighted field distribution "
                    "(mant 85% / exp 10% / sign 5%).")'''
new = '''p.add_argument("--fpu_fma_weighted", action="store_true",
               help="v1.1 Phase 9: fma_intermediate proxy — draw the flip "
                    "bit from method3's matched weighted field distribution "
                    "(mant 85% / exp 10% / sign 5%).")
# v1.1 Phase 9 mode 3 — recurring_result_stuck (pair with --max_faults 0).
p.add_argument("--fpu_recurring_stuck", action="store_true",
               help="v1.1 Phase 9: recurring_result_stuck — the SAME fixed "
                    "mask on every eligible FSU result (stuck multiplier "
                    "bit). Use with --max_faults 0.")'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, new)
old = '''        fmaWeighted=args.fpu_fma_weighted,
        writeLog=True,
    )
    board.chaos_fpu = fpu'''
new = '''        fmaWeighted=args.fpu_fma_weighted,
        recurringStuck=args.fpu_recurring_stuck,
        writeLog=True,
    )
    board.chaos_fpu = fpu'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p, "w").write(s)
print("config wired")

rm -rf /tmp/p9d_golden && numactl --cpunodebind=1 --membind=1 -- build/ARM/gem5.opt --quiet -d /tmp/p9d_golden configs/se/arm_chaos.py --cmd workloads/directed/reg_chain --cpu O3 2>&1 | tail -1
git add CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSFPU/ configs/se/arm_chaos.py && git commit -m "feat: v1.1 Phase 9 patch 1a mode 3 — CHAOSFPU recurring_result_stuck (permanent same-mask fault)

The SAME fixed mask on EVERY opClass-eligible FSU result — modeling a
stuck multiplier partial-product bit (the literature's dominant
execution-unit SDC source). Mask = directed --fault_mask if given, else
drawn once (uniform pick) on the first eligible event and reused for
the whole run. Pairs with maxFaults=0 (the Phase 8.4 runner contract
enforces it; --fpu_recurring_stuck + --max_faults 0). Log line carries
'mode=recurring_result_stuck'.

Real-machine verification (cholesky, first_clock=5000, max_faults=0,
seed 20260825): 6628 injections, distinct masks = 1 (constant
mask=0x4000000000), checksum d669c3de44c71ad0 != golden 37621bc0a633976f
-> SDC. The permanent recurring fault is dramatically more destructive
than the single-shot (2/4 SDC in patch 1a-0's test) — exactly the
contrast the Phase 9 campaign quantifies (acceptance: recurring P_SDC
must be significantly higher than single-shot F1 before any 'FSU is
SDC-blind' claim).

reg_chain golden regression f247ef3fe6f02cfd, exit=0. Rebuild clean." && git push origin fix/fi-tool-correctness 2>&1 | tail -1

content.text: Mode 3 提交(121a07b)。Modes 4-6(rounding_sub / f3_data_dependent / fpsr_suppress)是三个小模式——实现它们:

input.command:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
# Modes 4-6 in one sweep (small, independent):
# mode 4 rounding_sub: flip the rounding-mode field of the injected result's
#   semantics — E3 proxy: XOR the result's low mantissa bit(s) by
#   re-rounding the value to the NEIGHBORING representable (round-toward-
#   opposite). Simplest honest proxy: add/sub one ULP on the double
#   (toggle toward ±inf based on current rounding). Implementation: read
#   the PRF double, compute nextafter(value, ±inf), write back.
# mode 5 f3_data_dependent: only corrupt when the operand falls in a value
#   range — proxy on the RESULT value: corrupt only if the double's
#   exponent field is within [lo, hi] (configurable via --fpu_operand_range
#   "lo,hi" on the biased exponent).
# mode 6 fpsr_suppress: clear the FP exception flags (FPSR read via TC is
#   not reachable here) — E3 proxy: on eligible events, clear the sticky
#   IOC/IXC bits by reading misc reg? DynInst::execute has the TC path;
#   honest alternative: no-op corrupt with log (the flag effect needs an
#   MRS read to matter). Implement as: corrupt nothing, log
#   'mode=fpsr_suppress cleared=<n>' counting events — behavior-level
#   placeholder with honest logging.
p = "CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSFPU/CHAOSFPU.py"
s = open(p).read()
old = '''    recurringStuck = Param.Bool(False, "recurring_result_stuck mode: same "
                                       "fixed mask on every eligible result")'''
new = '''    recurringStuck = Param.Bool(False, "recurring_result_stuck mode: same "
                                       "fixed mask on every eligible result")
    # v1.1 Phase 9 patch 1a mode 4 — rounding_sub (F5, E3 proxy): re-round
    # the injected double one ULP toward the OPPOSITE of the current
    # rounding direction (nearest -> the value's other neighbor). Models a
    # flipped RMODE field in FPCR changing one rounding decision.
    roundingSub = Param.Bool(False, "rounding_sub mode: nudge the result "
                                    "one ULP to the opposite neighbor")
    # mode 5 — f3_data_dependent: corrupt ONLY when the result double's
    # biased exponent falls in [expLo, expHi] (the --fpu_operand_range
    # proxy; -1..-1 = unrestricted).
    f3Dependent = Param.Bool(False, "f3_data_dependent mode: corrupt only "
                                    "when the result exponent is in range")
    expLo = Param.Int(-1, "f3 operand-range lower bound (biased exp, incl.)")
    expHi = Param.Int(-1, "f3 operand-range upper bound (biased exp, incl.)")
    # mode 6 — fpsr_suppress (E3 placeholder): consume eligible events and
    # clear the accumulated exception-state model; the arch FPSR is only
    # observable via an MRS read, which SE kernels never take — logged
    # honestly as a count of suppressed-flag events.
    fpsrSuppress = Param.Bool(False, "fpsr_suppress mode: clear FP "
                                     "exception flags (logged count)")'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
open(p, "w").write(s.replace(old, new))
print("py patched")

p = "CHAOS/gem5/src/cpu/o3/CHAOSFPU/CHAOSFPU.hh"
s = open(p).read()
old = '''    // mode 3 — recurring_result_stuck: same fixed mask every event.
    bool recurring_stuck = false;
    uint64_t recurring_mask = 0;      // drawn once on the first event
    bool recurring_mask_drawn = false;'''
new = '''    // mode 3 — recurring_result_stuck: same fixed mask every event.
    bool recurring_stuck = false;
    uint64_t recurring_mask = 0;      // drawn once on the first event
    bool recurring_mask_drawn = false;
    // mode 4 — rounding_sub: one-ULP opposite-neighbor nudge.
    bool rounding_sub = false;
    // mode 5 — f3_data_dependent: exponent-window gate.
    bool f3_dependent = false;
    int exp_lo = -1, exp_hi = -1;
    // mode 6 — fpsr_suppress: logged count of cleared-flag events.
    bool fpsr_suppress = false;
    uint64_t suppressed_count = 0;'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
open(p, "w").write(s.replace(old, new))
print("hh patched")
PYEOF

# 下一步计划：鲲鹏920 SDC 故障注入 — S2/S3 收尾 → 网格深化 → F5/F6 → FS → v1.1 补救轮

> 依据 `docs/KUNPENG920-故障注入方案详细工程设计.md`（§3.1 阶段表）× 仓库实际进展（HEAD af64ef7 + 未提交 formal 结果）编写。
> **v1.1 补救轮（Phase 8–12）** 依据工程设计文档 v1.1（§1.3 故障模型必跑矩阵 + §1.7 负载/oracle 纪律 + §2.3/2.6/2.8/2.17）× `KUNPENG920-v1.1补救轮执行计划.md`；落地仓库 `gem5-fi/`（分支 `fix/fi-tool-correctness`，真 HEAD `4bf8d0d` = 238 commits）。
> 本计划是**工作计划**；证据审计结论见 `findings.md`。

## Goal

把"每个单元 1 个 cell 的 n=384 formal"推进为设计文档要求的**有意义网格 + protection-aware 对照 + F5/F6 机理模式 + FS 管线**，期间修复已发现的工具正确性 bug（本分支主题），最终产出可信的 §4.1 逃逸分解与 §4.2 保护投资排序。

## 现状一句话总结（详见 findings.md）

S1 四个 P0 单元 + S2/S3 六个 SE 单元 formal 已完成（单 cell × n=384）；核心格局：**乱序后端（PRF/RAT/LSQFwd）DUE 主导 92–100%，存储（L1D）SDC 主导 97.7%，执行/IQ/译码/BPU/RAS 全 Masked**。但存在：① mem_formal 全 Inactive（CHAOSMem 频率 bug，同 8bff9d1 修过的那类）；② 6 个 formal 结果未提交；③ 几乎所有 formal 只跑了 `protection_model=none` 单组、单 fault_model、target_index=0 单 cell —— 与设计文档 §1.2/§2.x C 的网格规格相差甚远；④ F5/F6 子模式（ROB spec_leak、IQ src_ready/tag_sub、LSQFwd fwd_source_sub/phaseOffset、TLB pfn→活页）全部 deferred；⑤ FS 管线（kp920_proxy_fs V110 参数、checkpoint 流水线、PTW H7 formal）未落地。

---

## Phase 1 — 工具正确性 + 在手结果落盘（本分支主题，最高优先）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

1. ✅ 6 个 formal 提交（d4c9e8b）：bpu/decode/ras/iq 全 Masked 384/384；mem 标注无效。
2. ✅ CHAOSMem 频率 bug 修复（b7433dd）：ratio 由时钟频率按 gem5 舍入规则计算（C2→385，C0→500）。真机验证 Tick 精确等于 first_clock×ratio。
3. ✅ mem_formal 重跑（d88dcc7）：**VALID，384/384 Masked，P_SDC=0% [0,1.0]**——DRAM 后备字节被 L1/L2 缓存掩盖（与 L1D 97.7% SDC 对照鲜明）。附带修复 campaign.py --jobs>1 pickle bug（_PoolRep 模块级类；此前所有 formal 都是串行跑的，掩盖了此 bug）。

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

## Phase 2 — protection-aware 第二组（§1.2 核心缺口，改结论级别的补强）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

input.command:
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p = "configs/se/arm_chaos.py"
s = open(p).read()
old = '''p.add_argument("--fpu_recurring_stuck", action="store_true",
               help="v1.1 Phase 9: recurring_result_stuck — the SAME fixed "
                    "mask on every eligible FSU result (stuck multiplier "
                    "bit). Use with --max_faults 0.")'''
new = '''p.add_argument("--fpu_recurring_stuck", action="store_true",
               help="v1.1 Phase 9: recurring_result_stuck — the SAME fixed "
                    "mask on every eligible FSU result (stuck multiplier "
                    "bit). Use with --max_faults 0.")
# v1.1 Phase 9 modes 4-6.
p.add_argument("--fpu_rounding_sub", action="store_true",
               help="v1.1 Phase 9 mode 4: rounding_sub — one-ULP nudge to "
                    "the opposite rounding neighbor (E3 proxy for flipped "
                    "FPCR RMODE).")
p.add_argument("--fpu_f3_dependent", action="store_true",
               help="v1.1 Phase 9 mode 5: f3_data_dependent — corrupt only "
                    "when the result exponent is within --fpu_exp_range.")
p.add_argument("--fpu_exp_range", default="-1,-1",
               help="mode 5 exponent window 'lo,hi' (biased exponent, "
                    "inclusive; -1,-1 = unrestricted).")
p.add_argument("--fpu_fpsr_suppress", action="store_true",
               help="v1.1 Phase 9 mode 6: fpsr_suppress — clear FP "
                    "exception flags (E3 placeholder, logged count).")'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, new)
old = '''        recurringStuck=args.fpu_recurring_stuck,
        writeLog=True,
    )
    board.chaos_fpu = fpu'''
new = '''        recurringStuck=args.fpu_recurring_stuck,
        roundingSub=args.fpu_rounding_sub,
        f3Dependent=args.fpu_f3_dependent,
        expLo=int(args.fpu_exp_range.split(",")[0]),
        expHi=int(args.fpu_exp_range.split(",")[1]),
        fpsrSuppress=args.fpu_fpsr_suppress,
        writeLog=True,
    )
    board.chaos_fpu = fpu'''
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p, "w").write(s)
print("config wired")

mode 4 rounding_sub (--fpu_rounding_sub): one-ULP nudge of the result
double to the OPPOSITE rounding neighbor (toward ±inf based on the
mantissa LSB) — E3 behavioral proxy for a flipped FPCR RMODE changing
one rounding decision. Value-level rewrite via the PRF pointer
(std::nextafter), log line 'mode=rounding_sub'.

mode 5 f3_data_dependent (--fpu_f3_dependent --fpu_exp_range lo,hi):
corrupt ONLY when the first FP/vector dest's biased exponent falls in
[lo,hi]. The plan's triggerValueMask/Pattern needs the OPERANDS, which
are gone post-execute — the result exponent is the honest post-hoc
proxy (--fpu_operand_range equivalent).

mode 6 fpsr_suppress (--fpu_fpsr_suppress): E3 placeholder — the arch
FPSR is only observable via an MRS read, which SE kernels never take;
counts suppressed-flag events and corrupts nothing (honest no-op, not
a fake pass).

  bit-flip signature 2d853a3c6fbef5a9 — the 1-ULP nudge produces its
  own corruption), log 'mode=rounding_sub, faults_injected: 1'.
- f3_data_dependent window [1020,1030]: injection lands (mask=0x4,
  checksum 2d853a3c6fbef5a9); window [1,100]: ZERO injections,
  checksum == golden 37621bc0a633976f (gate blocks — the negative
  control).
- fpsr_suppress: checksum == golden, zero corruption lines (honest).

Bug found during acceptance: the modes 4-6 ctor initializers were
missing (first patch script died on a later anchor before completing
the init list — the members stayed false and the mode flags silently
did nothing while config.ini showed them set). Fixed; lesson recorded:
verify param->member->behavior, not just config.ini.

reg_chain golden regression f247ef3fe6f02cfd, exit=0. Rebuild clean.
All six Phase 9 modes now ride the PRF-dest path: bitseg(6 segments),
fma_intermediate(E3 weighted), recurring_result_stuck, rounding_sub,
f3_data_dependent, fpsr_suppress." && git push origin fix/fi-tool-correctness 2>&1 | tail -1

input.command:
# Injection smoke: FPU on the FMA loops
for seed in 11 12; do
rm -rf /tmp/p9g_s$seed
out=$(numactl --cpunodebind=1 --membind=1 -- build/ARM/gem5.opt --quiet -d /tmp/p9g_s$seed configs/se/arm_chaos.py --cmd workloads/directed/elemwise_fma_kernel --cpu O3 --chaos_fpu --fpu_first_clock 5000 --fpu_max_faults 1 --fpu_rng_seed $seed 2>&1 | grep -E "ARRAYHASH|ULP" | tr '\n' ' ')
echo "seed=$seed $out inj=[$(head -1 /tmp/p9g_s$seed/fpu_injections.log | cut -c1-60)]"
done

# 下一步计划：鲲鹏920 SDC 故障注入 — S2/S3 收尾 → 网格深化 → F5/F6 → FS → v1.1 补救轮

> 依据 `docs/KUNPENG920-故障注入方案详细工程设计.md`（§3.1 阶段表）× 仓库实际进展（HEAD af64ef7 + 未提交 formal 结果）编写。
> **v1.1 补救轮（Phase 8–12）** 依据工程设计文档 v1.1（§1.3 故障模型必跑矩阵 + §1.7 负载/oracle 纪律 + §2.3/2.6/2.8/2.17）× `KUNPENG920-v1.1补救轮执行计划.md`；落地仓库 `gem5-fi/`（分支 `fix/fi-tool-correctness`，真 HEAD `4bf8d0d` = 238 commits）。
> 本计划是**工作计划**；证据审计结论见 `findings.md`。

## Goal

把"每个单元 1 个 cell 的 n=384 formal"推进为设计文档要求的**有意义网格 + protection-aware 对照 + F5/F6 机理模式 + FS 管线**，期间修复已发现的工具正确性 bug（本分支主题），最终产出可信的 §4.1 逃逸分解与 §4.2 保护投资排序。

## 现状一句话总结（详见 findings.md）

S1 四个 P0 单元 + S2/S3 六个 SE 单元 formal 已完成（单 cell × n=384）；核心格局：**乱序后端（PRF/RAT/LSQFwd）DUE 主导 92–100%，存储（L1D）SDC 主导 97.7%，执行/IQ/译码/BPU/RAS 全 Masked**。但存在：① mem_formal 全 Inactive（CHAOSMem 频率 bug，同 8bff9d1 修过的那类）；② 6 个 formal 结果未提交；③ 几乎所有 formal 只跑了 `protection_model=none` 单组、单 fault_model、target_index=0 单 cell —— 与设计文档 §1.2/§2.x C 的网格规格相差甚远；④ F5/F6 子模式（ROB spec_leak、IQ src_ready/tag_sub、LSQFwd fwd_source_sub/phaseOffset、TLB pfn→活页）全部 deferred；⑤ FS 管线（kp920_proxy_fs V110 参数、checkpoint 流水线、PTW H7 formal）未落地。

---

## Phase 1 — 工具正确性 + 在手结果落盘（本分支主题，最高优先）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

1. ✅ 6 个 formal 提交（d4c9e8b）：bpu/decode/ras/iq 全 Masked 384/384；mem 标注无效。
2. ✅ CHAOSMem 频率 bug 修复（b7433dd）：ratio 由时钟频率按 gem5 舍入规则计算（C2→385，C0→500）。真机验证 Tick 精确等于 first_clock×ratio。
3. ✅ mem_formal 重跑（d88dcc7）：**VALID，384/384 Masked，P_SDC=0% [0,1.0]**——DRAM 后备字节被 L1/L2 缓存掩盖（与 L1D 97.7% SDC 对照鲜明）。附带修复 campaign.py --jobs>1 pickle bug（_PoolRep 模块级类；此前所有 formal 都是串行跑的，掩盖了此 bug）。

**验收**：✅ mem formal n_valid=384>0；✅ reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归通过。

## Phase 2 — protection-aware 第二组（§1.2 核心缺口，改结论级别的补强）

**Status: complete（2026-09-03）**

content.subject: Phase 8.1 — 非 hash oracle(classify/runner/campaign/schema)
content.description: classify_run() 加 oracle_kind 参数(array_hash/per_element_diff/fp_ulp);runner.py GOLDEN_ARRAYS 注册表 + oracle.kind/tol 透传;campaign.py manifest_for_cell() 写 workload.oracle_kind/oracle_tol;manifest.schema.json v2 enum 增补。验收:烟雾 kernel 手工注入验证三种 oracle + reg_chain exact_hash 不变。

content.subject: Phase 8.2 — events_to_skip 均匀采样
content.description: 新 src/cpu/o3/chaos_event_sample.hh:pickSkip(seed,nEligible)=rng%nEligible + countOnlyMode 打印 CHAOS_ELIGIBLE_COUNT。campaign.py dry-run 计数 N_eligible → skip=uniform。六注入器(FPU/Exec/L1DForward/LSQFwd/IQ/ROB)采样切 helper。验收:同 cell 5 seed 注入事件分散 + reg_chain golden 回归。

content.subject: Phase 8.3 — CHAOSCache/CHAOSMem local_mbu 多位档
content.description: faultMask=0 时按 bitsToChange 生成相邻多位掩码;applyProtection() 2-bit(poison/Latent)与 ≥3-bit(SilentEscape)分支走通。验收:secded_poison+bits=2→log Latent;bits=3→SilentEscape。

content.subject: Phase 8.4 — recurring_result_stuck 单故障契约松绑
content.description: runner.py 仅 fault.model==recurring_result_stuck 时允许 max_faults==0;campaign.py 对该模型 cell 发 limits.max_faults=0;schemas 放开。验收:recurring cell 跑通 N>1 损坏+九类结局+Wilson CI;transient cell 仍断言 ∈{0,1}。

content.subject: Phase 8 总验收
content.description: 0a–0d 四项验收 + reg_chain golden f247ef3fe6f02cfd 回归(exit 0,零 SIGSEGV)。更新 progress.md/task_plan.md。

content.subject: Phase 9 1a-0 — CHAOSFPU PRF-dest 路径重写(前置)
content.description: Phase 9 patch 1a 前置:CHAOSFPU 腐蚀路径从 instResult 队列(checker-only,架构不可见)改为 PRF-dest(FP/SIMD 经 getWritableRegOperand 的 VecRegContainer;整数经 setRegOperand)。真机验收:注入后 ELEMDIFF/校验和真实变化(可观察 SDC 或 Masked 由故障决定,但不再是恒不变)。
content.activeForm: 重写 CHAOSFPU 注入点为 PRF-dest 路径

content.description: bitseg(sign/exp_hi/exp_lo/mant_hi/mant_mid/mant_lo)/fma_intermediate(E3 行为代理)/recurring_result_stuck/rounding_sub/f3_data_dependent/fpsr_suppress,每模式 1 补丁。
